question: List Shepherd's stats in overs 19-20 while batting(runs, balls, dismissals, strike rate, fours and sixes)
gold_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS "Runs",
  COUNT(T1.delivery_id) AS "Balls",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.player_out_id = T2.player_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Dismissals",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs_scored = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Fours",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Sixes",
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.delivery_id) AS "Strike_Rate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
WHERE
  T2.player_name LIKE 'R Shepherd%' AND T1.over_number >= 18 AND NOT (
    T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL
  );
generated_sql:
WITH shepherd_batting AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(*) AS balls,
        SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals,
        SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fours,
        SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sixes
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE striker_id = (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE player_name = 'Shepherd')
      AND over_number BETWEEN 19 AND 20
      AND wides = 0
      AND noballs = 0
)
SELECT
    total_runs AS "Total Runs",
    balls AS "Balls",
    dismissals AS "Dismissals",
    fours AS "Fours",
    sixes AS "Sixes",
    ROUND((total_runs * 100.0) / balls, 2) AS "Strike Rate"
FROM shepherd_batting;

question: उन सभी बल्लेबाज़ों की सूची बनाएं जिन्होंने IPL में किसी एक टीम के खिलाफ़ 1000 या उससे ज़्यादा रन बनाए हैं।
gold_sql:
SELECT
  "striker",
  CASE
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Deccan Chargers'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Sunrisers Hyderabad' THEN 'Hyderabad'
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Delhi Daredevils'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Delhi Capitals' THEN 'Delhi'
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Kings XI Punjab'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Punjab Kings' THEN 'Punjab'
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Pune Warriors'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Rising Pune Supergiants' THEN 'Pune'
    ELSE "bowling_team"
  END AS Opponent,
  SUM("runs_scored") AS TotalRuns
FROM "Deliveries"
GROUP BY
  "striker",
  Opponent
HAVING
  SUM("runs_scored") >= 1000
ORDER BY
  TotalRuns DESC;

question: List the most sixes hit by a punjab batter in a season.
gold_sql:
SELECT

  T2."season",

  ON T1."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1."batting_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') AND T1."runs_scored" = 6

gold_answer: ["('Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad', '2025-06-01')", "('Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai', '2025-04-07')", "('Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium, Lucknow', '2024-04-30')", "('Sawai Mansingh Stadium, Jaipur', '2024-04-22')", "('Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai', '2024-04-14')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT venue AS Venue, match_date AS "Match Date"
FROM Matches
WHERE match_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT Deliveries.match_id
    FROM Deliveries
    JOIN Players ON Deliveries.bowler_id = Players.player_id
    WHERE Players.player_name = 'Bumrah'
      AND Deliveries.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
      AND Deliveries.wides = 0
      AND Deliveries.noballs = 0
);

question: उन मैचों की लिस्ट बताइए जिनमें Bumrah विकेटलेस रहे।
gold_sql: SELECT T1.venue, T1.match_date FROM Matches AS T1 INNER JOIN PlayerInMatch AS T2 ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id INNER JOIN Players AS T3 ON T2.player_id = T3.player_id WHERE T3.player_name = 'JJ Bumrah' AND T1.match_id NOT IN (SELECT T4.match_id FROM Deliveries AS T4 INNER JOIN Players AS T5 ON T4.bowler_id = T5.player_id WHERE T5.player_name = 'JJ Bumrah' AND T4.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND T4.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')) ORDER BY T1.match_date DESC LIMIT 5
gold_answer: ["('Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad', '2025-06-01')", "('Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai', '2025-04-07')", "('Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium, Lucknow', '2024-04-30')", "('Sawai Mansingh Stadium, Jaipur', '2024-04-22')", "('Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai', '2024-04-14')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.venue AS Venue, m.match_date AS "Match Date"
FROM Matches m
JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Bumrah'
AND m.match_id NOT IN (
    SELECT d.match_id
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Bumrah'
    AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
);

gold_sql: SELECT T2.player_name, COUNT(T1.match_id) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT match_id, bowler_id FROM Deliveries WHERE wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')) AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1.bowler_id = T2.player_id WHERE T1.bowler_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) >= 50) GROUP BY T2.player_name ORDER BY COUNT(T1.match_id) DESC LIMIT 5
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerMatches AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matches_played
    FROM PlayerInMatch
    WHERE player_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT bowler_id FROM Deliveries)
    GROUP BY player_id
    HAVING matches_played >= 50
),
BowlerWickets AS (
    SELECT bowler_id, COUNT(*) AS wickets_taken
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE wicket_type IS NOT NULL
    AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY bowler_id
)
SELECT p.player_name AS "Player Name", MAX(bw.wickets_taken) AS "Wickets Taken"
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerMatches pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN BowlerWickets bw ON p.player_id = bw.bowler_id
GROUP BY p.player_id
ORDER BY "Wickets Taken" DESC;

question: List all instances of a knockout match where a team scored 200+ but none of the players scored a half century.
gold_sql: SELECT T2."match_date", T2."venue", T1."batting_team", SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS "total_runs" FROM "Deliveries" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" WHERE T2."stage" != 'Group' GROUP BY T1."match_id", T1."inning", T1."batting_team" HAVING SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") >= 200 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Deliveries" AS D2 WHERE D2."match_id" = T1."match_id" AND D2."inning" = T1."inning" GROUP BY D2."striker_id" HAVING SUM(D2."runs_scored") >= 50) ORDER BY T2."match_date" DESC
generated_sql:
SELECT m.match_date AS "Match Date", 
       m.venue AS "Venue", 
       d.batting_team AS "Batting Team", 
       SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS "Total Runs"
FROM Matches m
JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE m.stage IN ('Final', 'Semi Final', 'Quarter Final') 
AND d.inning IN (1, 2)
GROUP BY m.match_id, d.batting_team
HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) >= 200
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Deliveries d2

    AND d2.batting_team = d.batting_team
    GROUP BY d2.striker_id
    HAVING SUM(d2.runs_scored) >= 50
)
ORDER BY m.match_date;

gold_sql: SELECT T2."match_date", T2."venue", T1."batting_team", SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS "total_runs" FROM "Deliveries" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" WHERE T2."stage" != 'Group' GROUP BY T1."match_id", T1."inning", T1."batting_team" HAVING SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") >= 200 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Deliveries" AS D2 WHERE D2."match_id" = T1."match_id" AND D2."inning" = T1."inning" GROUP BY D2."striker_id" HAVING SUM(D2."runs_scored") >= 50) ORDER BY T2."match_date" DESC
generated_sql:
WITH KnockoutMatches AS (
    SELECT match_id, match_date, venue, team1, team2
    FROM Matches
    WHERE stage IN ('Final', 'Semi Final', 'Quarter Final')
),
TeamScores AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.match_id, 
        dm.batting_team, 
        SUM(dm.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM Deliveries dm
    JOIN KnockoutMatches km ON dm.match_id = km.match_id
    GROUP BY dm.match_id, dm.batting_team
    HAVING SUM(dm.runs_scored) > 200
),
PlayerScores AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.match_id, 
        dm.batting_team, 
        dm.striker_id, 
        SUM(dm.runs_scored) AS player_runs
    FROM Deliveries dm
    JOIN TeamScores ts ON dm.match_id = ts.match_id AND dm.batting_team = ts.batting_team
    GROUP BY dm.match_id, dm.batting_team, dm.striker_id
),
FilteredTeams AS (
    SELECT ts.match_id, ts.batting_team, ts.total_runs
    FROM TeamScores ts
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM PlayerScores ps
        WHERE ps.match_id = ts.match_id 
        AND ps.batting_team = ts.batting_team 
        AND ps.player_runs >= 50
    )
)
SELECT 
    km.match_date AS "Match Date", 
    km.venue AS "Venue", 
    ft.batting_team AS "Batting Team", 
    ft.total_runs AS "Total Runs"
FROM FilteredTeams ft
JOIN KnockoutMatches km ON ft.match_id = km.match_id;

question: Show players who scored more than 750 runs in a single IPL season.

  ON T1."striker_id" = T3."player_id"

  T2."season",

ORDER BY

question: IPL 2025 में, 7 से 15 ओवर के बीच Bumrah के गेंदबाज़ी के आँकड़े दिखाइए।

SELECT
  SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS "Runs Conceded",
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND T1."player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
      THEN 1
    END

  CAST(COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS REAL) / 6.0 AS "Overs Bowled",
  CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS REAL) * 6.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1."delivery_id"), 0) AS "Economy Rate",
  CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND T1."player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
      THEN 1
    END
  ), 0) AS "Average",
  CAST(COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND T1."player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
      THEN 1
    END
  ), 0) AS "Strike Rate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
INNER JOIN Players AS T3
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id"

gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", COUNT(T1."delivery_id") FROM "Deliveries" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Players" AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" WHERE T1."runs_scored" = 6 GROUP BY T2."player_name" HAVING COUNT(T1."delivery_id") >= 300 ORDER BY COUNT(T1."delivery_id") DESC LIMIT 5
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS "Player Name", COUNT(*) AS "Total Sixes"
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE d.runs_scored = 6 AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY p.player_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 300
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

question: పురుషుల T20 పోటీలలో అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ 25+ స్కోర్లు తెచ్చుకున్న క్రీడాకార్లు ఎవరు?
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerScores AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS "total_runs"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  p."player_name",
  COUNT(ps."striker_id") AS "num_25_plus_scores"
FROM PlayerScores AS ps
JOIN "Players" AS p
  ON ps."striker_id" = p."player_id"
WHERE
  ps."total_runs" >= 25
GROUP BY
  p."player_name"
ORDER BY
  "num_25_plus_scores" DESC
LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS "Player Name",
    COUNT(*) AS "Number of 25+ Scores"
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY 
    d.striker_id, p.player_name
HAVING 
    SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 25
ORDER BY 
    COUNT(*) DESC;

question: IPL ప్లేఆఫ్స్‌్‌్‌ లో MI యొక్క అత్యాధికా పరుగుల సాధించిన ఓపెనింగ్ జంటలు ఏవరు?
gold_sql:
WITH MI_Playoff_Innings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    T1.match_id,
    T2.inning
  FROM Matches AS T1
  INNER JOIN Deliveries AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
  WHERE
    T1.stage <> 'Group' AND T2.batting_team = 'Mumbai Indians'
), First_Wicket_Deliveries AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    inning,
    MIN(delivery_id) AS first_wicket_delivery
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    player_out_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    match_id,
    inning
), Opening_Partnerships AS (
  SELECT
    T1.match_id,
    T1.inning,
    SUM(T3.runs_scored + T3.extra_runs) AS partnership_runs
  FROM MI_Playoff_Innings AS T1
  LEFT JOIN First_Wicket_Deliveries AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id AND T1.inning = T2.inning
  INNER JOIN Deliveries AS T3
    ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id AND T1.inning = T3.inning
  WHERE
    T3.delivery_id < T2.first_wicket_delivery OR T2.first_wicket_delivery IS NULL

question: List matches where MI scored 80 or more runs for the first wicket in IPL playoffs.
gold_sql:
WITH MI_Playoff_Deliveries AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."runs_scored",
    T1."extra_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."inning" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS wicket_group
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."stage" != 'Group' AND T1."batting_team" = 'Mumbai Indians'
), First_Wicket_Partnerships AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS first_wicket_runs
  FROM MI_Playoff_Deliveries
  WHERE
    wicket_group = 0
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
)
SELECT
  T1."match_date",
  T1."venue",
  CASE
    WHEN T1."team1" = 'Mumbai Indians' THEN T1."team2"
    ELSE T1."team1"
  END AS opponent,
  T2.first_wicket_runs
FROM "Matches" AS T1
INNER JOIN First_Wicket_Partnerships AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T2.first_wicket_runs >= 80
ORDER BY
  T2.first_wicket_runs DESC
LIMIT 5;

FROM

JOIN

question: उन टीमों को दिखाएँ जिन्होंने एक IPL सीज़न के सभी लीग मैचों में अपने टॉप तीन बल्लेबाज़ नहीं बदले।
gold_sql:
WITH BattingOrder AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."batting_team",
    T1."striker_id",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."batting_team" ORDER BY T1.first_ball_faced) AS batting_position
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "match_id",
      "batting_team",
      "striker_id",
      MIN("delivery_id") AS first_ball_faced
    FROM "Deliveries"
    GROUP BY
      "match_id",
      "batting_team",
      "striker_id"
  ) AS T1
), MatchTop3Lineup AS (
  SELECT
    M."season",
    B."batting_team",
    GROUP_CONCAT(B."striker_id" ORDER BY B.batting_position) AS top_3_batters
  FROM BattingOrder AS B
  JOIN "Matches" AS M
    ON B.match_id = M.match_id
  WHERE
    B.batting_position <= 3 AND M."stage" = 'Group'
  GROUP BY
    M."season",
    B.match_id,
    B."batting_team"
  HAVING
    COUNT(B."striker_id") = 3
)
SELECT
  "season",
  "batting_team"
FROM MatchTop3Lineup
GROUP BY
  "season",
  "batting_team"
HAVING
  COUNT(DISTINCT top_3_batters) = 1 AND COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY
  "season" DESC
LIMIT 5;

gold_answer: ["(48, 'Kolkata Knight Riders', '2017')", "(82, 'Sunrisers Hyderabad', '2009/10')", "(86, 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru', '2009/10')", "(87, 'Delhi Capitals', '2007/08')", "(101, 'Lucknow Super Giants', '2023')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS 'Total Runs', batting_team AS 'Batting Team', season AS 'Season'
FROM Deliveries
JOIN Matches ON Deliveries.match_id = Matches.match_id
WHERE stage = 'Playoff' AND inning = 1
GROUP BY Deliveries.match_id, batting_team, season
ORDER BY 'Total Runs' ASC
LIMIT 5;

question: Show all the bowlers who have bowled maiden overs bowled in powerplay overs in IPL 2025.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3."player_name" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" INNER JOIN Players AS T3 ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id" WHERE T2."season" = '2025' AND T1."over_number" <= 5 GROUP BY T1."match_id", T1."inning", T1."over_number", T1."bowler_id" HAVING SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") = 0;
gold_answer: ["('JC Archer',)", "('VG Arora',)", "('Mukesh Kumar',)", "('MM Ali',)", "('DL Chahar',)", "('KA Jamieson',)"]
generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name AS "Player Name"
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season = 'IPL 2025'
AND d.inning IN (1, 2)
AND d.over_number BETWEEN 1 AND 6

    SELECT bowler_id
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE match_id = d.match_id
    AND inning = d.inning

question: What is punjab's lowest score at the fall of 5th wicket in ipl 2025?
gold_sql:
WITH PunjabDeliveries AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."over_number",
    T1."ball_number",
    T1."runs_scored",
    T1."extra_runs",
    T1."player_out_id"
  FROM Deliveries AS T1
  INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."season" = '2025' AND T1."batting_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
), RunningTotals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "running_score",
    COUNT("player_out_id") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "wickets_fallen"
  FROM PunjabDeliveries
)
SELECT
  MIN("running_score")
FROM RunningTotals
WHERE
  "wickets_fallen" = 5;
generated_sql:
WITH PunjabWickets AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        inning,
        SUM(runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY delivery_id) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY delivery_id) AS wickets_fallen
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE batting_team = 'Punjab' AND season = '2025'
)
SELECT MIN(total_runs) AS "Minimum Score at 5 Wickets"
FROM PunjabWickets
WHERE wickets_fallen = 5;

question: List the top 5 bowlers with the best economy rate in overs 1–6 in IPL 2025 among those who bowled 15 or more overs.
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS REAL) * 6.0 / COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS economy FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T3 ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id" INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."player_id" WHERE T3."season" = '2025' AND T1."over_number" <= 5 GROUP BY T1."bowler_id" HAVING COUNT(T1."delivery_id") >= 90 ORDER BY economy ASC LIMIT 5
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS 'Player Name', 
       ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT d.over_number + (d.inning - 1) * 100), 2) AS Economy
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season = 'IPL 2025'
AND d.over_number BETWEEN 1 AND 6
AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY d.bowler_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.over_number + (d.inning - 1) * 100) >= 15
ORDER BY Economy
LIMIT 5;

question: IPL 2025 के उन टॉप 5 गेंदबाज़ों के नाम बताएं जिनका पावरप्ले (ओवर 1-6) में इकोनॉमी रेट सबसे बेहतरीन रहा हो, और जिन्होंने कम से कम 15 ओवर डाले हों।
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS REAL) * 6.0 / COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS economy FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T3 ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id" INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."player_id" WHERE T3."season" = '2025' AND T1."over_number" <= 5 GROUP BY T1."bowler_id" HAVING COUNT(T1."delivery_id") >= 90 ORDER BY economy ASC LIMIT 5
generated_sql:
WITH PowerplayDeliveries AS (
    SELECT 
        d.bowler_id,
        d.runs_scored,
        d.extra_runs
    FROM 
        Deliveries d
    JOIN 
        Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE 
        m.season = 'IPL 2025'
        AND d.inning IN (1, 2)
        AND d.over_number BETWEEN 1 AND 6
        AND d.wides = 0
        AND d.noballs = 0
),
BowlerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        pd.bowler_id,
        SUM(pd.runs_scored + pd.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(*) / 6.0 AS total_overs
    FROM 
        PowerplayDeliveries pd
    GROUP BY 
        pd.bowler_id
    HAVING 
        COUNT(*) / 6.0 >= 15
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS 'Player Name',
    ROUND(bs.total_runs / bs.total_overs, 2) AS Economy
FROM 
    BowlerStats bs
JOIN 
    Players p ON bs.bowler_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY 
    Economy ASC
LIMIT 5;

question: IPL 2025 में न्यूनतम 15 ओवर फेंकने वाले गेंदबाज़ों में से, ओवर 1-6 में सर्वश्रेष्ठ इकोनॉमी रेट वाले टॉप 5 गेंदबाज़ों की सूची दें।
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS REAL) * 6.0 / COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS economy FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T3 ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id" INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."player_id" WHERE T3."season" = '2025' AND T1."over_number" <= 5 GROUP BY T1."bowler_id" HAVING COUNT(T1."delivery_id") >= 90 ORDER BY economy ASC LIMIT 5
generated_sql:
WITH BowlerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler_id,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,
        SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE season = '2025')
    AND over_number BETWEEN 1 AND 6
    AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0
    GROUP BY bowler_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 90
),
EconomyRate AS (
    SELECT 
        bs.bowler_id,
        ROUND((bs.total_runs * 6.0) / COUNT(*), 2) AS Economy

question: IPL 2025 లో కనీసం 15 ఓవర్లు బౌలింగ్ చేసిన బౌలర్లలో, 1 నుంచి 6 ఓవర్లలో అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ ఎకానమీ రేట్ ఉన్న టాప్ 5 బౌలర్ల పేరులు రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS REAL) * 6.0 / COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS economy FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T3 ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id" INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."player_id" WHERE T3."season" = '2025' AND T1."over_number" <= 5 GROUP BY T1."bowler_id" HAVING COUNT(T1."delivery_id") >= 90 ORDER BY economy ASC LIMIT 5
generated_sql:
WITH BowlerStats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT match_id || '-' || inning || '-' || over_number) AS overs_bowled,
        SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS wickets_taken
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE season = '2025')
    GROUP BY bowler_id
    HAVING overs_bowled >= 15

EconomyInFirstSix AS (
    SELECT
        bowler_id,
        SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id || '-' || inning || '-' || over_number) AS economy,

    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE season = '2025')

JOIN Players p ON e.bowler_id = p.player_id

question: Show the team with the lowest economy rate and highest dot-ball percentage in IPL 2025 with the corresponding numbers.
gold_sql: WITH TeamStats AS (SELECT T1."bowling_team", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS REAL) * 6 / COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS economy, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1."runs_scored" = 0 AND T1."extra_runs" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS dot_percentage FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" WHERE T2."season" = '2025' GROUP BY T1."bowling_team"), RankedStats AS (SELECT "bowling_team", "economy", "dot_percentage", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "economy" ASC) AS economy_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "dot_percentage" DESC) AS dot_rank FROM TeamStats) SELECT "bowling_team", "economy", "dot_percentage" FROM RankedStats ORDER BY (economy_rank + dot_rank) ASC LIMIT 1
generated_sql:

    SELECT

question: IPL లో PBKS కి వెతిరేకంగా Virat Kohli యొక్క మొత్తం మీద బ్యాటింగ్ రికార్డు ఏమిటి - మ్యాచూలు, పరుగులు, ఆవెరేజ్, స్ట్రైక్ రేట్, శతకాలు మరియు అర్ధశతకాలు.
gold_sql:
WITH KohliMatchRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS runs,
    COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS balls
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  WHERE
    T1."striker_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" = 'V Kohli'
    ) AND T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id"
), KohliDismissals AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS dismissals
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  WHERE
    T1."player_out_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" = 'V Kohli'
    ) AND T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
)
SELECT
  COUNT(T1."match_id") AS "Matches",
  SUM(T1.runs) AS "Runs",
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs) AS REAL) / T2.dismissals AS "Average",
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(T1.balls) AS "Strike Rate",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Centuries",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs >= 50 AND T1.runs < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Fifties"
FROM KohliMatchRuns AS T1, KohliDismissals AS T2;

question: Show Kohli’s batting stats while chasing in IPL 2025 — runs, innings, average, and strike rate.
gold_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "Runs",
  COUNT(DISTINCT T1."match_id") AS "Innings",
  CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Average",
  CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS "Strike_Rate"
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T3."player_name" LIKE 'V Kohli%' AND T2."season" = '2025' AND T1."inning" = 2 AND NOT (
    T1."extra_runs" > 0 AND T1."runs_scored" = 0 AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL
  );
generated_sql:
WITH KohliChasing AS (
    SELECT 
        D.runs_scored,
        D.match_id,
        D.inning
    FROM 
        Deliveries D
    JOIN 
        Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id
    JOIN 
        Players P ON D.striker_id = P.player_id
    WHERE 
        P.player_name = 'Virat Kohli'
        AND M.season = '2025'
        AND (
            (M.toss_decision = 'field' AND D.batting_team = M.toss_winner)
            OR (M.toss_decision = 'bat' AND D.batting_team != M.toss_winner)
        )
)
SELECT 
    SUM(KC.runs_scored) AS [Total Runs],
    COUNT(DISTINCT KC.match_id) AS [Innings],
    ROUND(1.0 * SUM(KC.runs_scored) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN KC.runs_scored IS NOT NULL THEN KC.match_id END), 2) AS [Average],
    ROUND(1.0 * SUM(KC.runs_scored) / COUNT(CASE WHEN KC.runs_scored IS NOT NULL THEN KC.match_id END) * 100, 2) AS [Strike Rate]
FROM 
    KohliChasing KC;

        m.team2,
        pim.team_name AS kohli_team
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.striker_id = pim.player_id
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.payer_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Virat Kohli'
    AND (m.team1 = 'PBKS' OR m.team2 = 'PBKS')
    AND d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
),

KohliMatches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT match_id
    FROM KohliDeliveries
),

KohliRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_per_match
    FROM KohliDeliveries
    GROUP BY match_id
),

KohliStats AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KohliMatches) AS Matches,
        (SELECT SUM(runs_scored) FROM KohliDeliveries) AS 'Total Runs',
        (SELECT SUM(runs_scored) FROM KohliDeliveries) * 1.0 / 
            NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KohliMatches) - 
                   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KohliRuns WHERE runs_per_match = 0), 0) AS 'Batting Average',
        (SELECT SUM(runs_scored) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM KohliDeliveries) AS 'Strike Rate',
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KohliRuns WHERE runs_per_match >= 100) AS 'Centuries',
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KohliRuns WHERE runs_per_match BETWEEN 50 AND 99) AS 'Fifties'
)

SELECT 
    Matches,
    "Total Runs",
    ROUND("Batting Average", 2) AS "Batting Average",
    ROUND("Strike Rate", 2) AS "Strike Rate",
    "Centuries",
    "Fifties"
FROM KohliStats;

question: IPL में PBKS के खिलाफ़ विराट कोहली का कुल बल्लेबाज़ी रिकॉर्ड बताइए — मैच, रन, औसत, स्ट्राइक रेट, शतक और अर्धशतक।
gold_sql:
WITH KohliMatchRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS runs,
    COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS balls
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  WHERE
    T1."striker_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" = 'V Kohli'
    ) AND T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id"
), KohliDismissals AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS dismissals
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  WHERE
    T1."player_out_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" = 'V Kohli'
    ) AND T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
)
SELECT
  COUNT(T1."match_id") AS "Matches",
  SUM(T1.runs) AS "Runs",
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs) AS REAL) / T2.dismissals AS "Average",
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(T1.balls) AS "Strike Rate",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Centuries",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs >= 50 AND T1.runs < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Fifties"
FROM KohliMatchRuns AS T1, KohliDismissals AS T2;

        match_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_in_match
    FROM 
        ViratDeliveries
    GROUP BY 
        match_id
),
MatchStats AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        runs_in_match,
        CASE WHEN runs_in_match >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS century,
        CASE WHEN runs_in_match >= 50 AND runs_in_match < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fifty
    FROM 
        MatchRuns
)

    SUM(century) AS Centuries,
    SUM(fifty) AS Fifties
FROM 
    MatchStats ms
JOIN 
    ViratDeliveries vd ON ms.match_id = vd.match_id;

question: IPL 2025 में पॉवरप्ले, मिडिल ओवर्स, और डेथ ओवर्स में अय्यर का स्ट्राइक रेट बताइए।
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", CASE WHEN T1."over_number" <= 5 THEN 'Powerplay' WHEN T1."over_number" > 5 AND T1."over_number" <= 14 THEN 'Middle Overs' ELSE 'Death Overs' END AS match_phase, CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS strike_rate FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" INNER JOIN Matches AS T3 ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id" WHERE T2."player_name" LIKE '%Iyer%' AND T3."season" = '2025' AND NOT (T1."extra_runs" > 0 AND T1."runs_scored" = 0 AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL) GROUP BY T2."player_name", match_phase ORDER BY T2."player_name", CASE WHEN match_phase = 'Powerplay' THEN 1 WHEN match_phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
generated_sql:
WITH PhaseRunsBalls AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        CASE
            WHEN d.over_number BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
            WHEN d.over_number BETWEEN 7 AND 15 THEN 'Middle Overs'
            WHEN d.over_number BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN 'Death Overs'
        END AS MatchPhase,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS TotalRuns,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalBalls
    FROM 
        Deliveries d
        JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
        JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE 
        p.player_name = 'Iyer' 
        AND m.season = '2025'
        AND d.wides = 0 
        AND d.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY 
        p.player_name, MatchPhase
)
SELECT 
    player_name AS 'Player Name',
    MatchPhase AS 'Match Phase',
    ROUND((CAST(TotalRuns AS FLOAT) / TotalBalls) * 100, 2) AS 'Strike Rate'
FROM 
    PhaseRunsBalls
ORDER BY 
    MatchPhase;

question: what is the highest partnership for RCB for 5th wicket or lower in a run-chase.Give the batsman involved with the partnership.
gold_sql:
WITH WicketEvents AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored" + "extra_runs" AS "total_runs",
    CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "is_wicket"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2 AND "batting_team" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
), PartnershipGroups AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."non_striker_id",
    T1."total_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(T1."is_wicket") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS "wickets_down"
  FROM WicketEvents AS T1
  JOIN "Matches" AS M
    ON T1."match_id" = M."match_id"
  WHERE
    M."result_type" != 'no result'
), PartnershipStats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM("total_runs") AS "partnership_runs",
    MIN(CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END) AS "batsman1_id",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "striker_id" > "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END) AS "batsman2_id"
  FROM PartnershipGroups
  WHERE
    "wickets_down" >= 4
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "wickets_down"
)
SELECT
  PS."partnership_runs",
  P1."player_name",
  P2."player_name"
FROM PartnershipStats AS PS
JOIN "Players" AS P1
  ON PS."batsman1_id" = P1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS P2
  ON PS."batsman2_id" = P2."player_id"
ORDER BY
  PS."partnership_runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH RCBPartnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        d1.striker_id AS player1_id,
        d2.striker_id AS player2_id,

        MIN(d1.inning) AS inning,
        MIN(d1.match_id) AS match_id
    FROM Deliveries d1

question: Find the top 5 players with the highest strike rates who scored atleast 400 runs in an ipl season.
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T2."season",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs",
  CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."extra_runs" = 0
      OR T1."runs_scored" > 0
      OR T1."wicket_type" IS NOT NULL THEN 1
    END
  ) AS "strike_rate"
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T3."player_name",
  T2."season"
HAVING
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 400
ORDER BY
  "strike_rate" DESC
LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerSeasonStats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name AS "Player Name",
        m.season AS "Season",
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS "Total Runs",
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "Balls Faced"
    FROM 
        Deliveries d
    INNER JOIN 
        Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    INNER JOIN 
        Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY 
        p.player_name, m.season
)
SELECT 
    "Player Name",
    "Season",
    "Total Runs",
    ROUND(("Total Runs" * 1.0 / "Balls Faced") * 100, 2) AS "Strike Rate"
FROM 
    PlayerSeasonStats
WHERE 
    "Total Runs" >= 400
ORDER BY 
    "Strike Rate" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: Target ਦਾ ਪਿੱਛਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋਏ 5ਵੀਂ ਵਿਕਟ ਜਾਂ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਹੇਠਾਂ ਲਈ RCB ਦੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੀ ਸਾਂਝੇਦਾਰੀ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਹੈ? ਉਸ ਸਾਂਝੇਦਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ।
gold_sql:
WITH WicketEvents AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored" + "extra_runs" AS "total_runs",
    CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "is_wicket"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2 AND "batting_team" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
), PartnershipGroups AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."non_striker_id",
    T1."total_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(T1."is_wicket") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS "wickets_down"
  FROM WicketEvents AS T1
  JOIN "Matches" AS M
    ON T1."match_id" = M."match_id"
  WHERE
    M."result_type" != 'no result'
), PartnershipStats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM("total_runs") AS "partnership_runs",
    MIN(CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END) AS "batsman1_id",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "striker_id" > "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END) AS "batsman2_id"
  FROM PartnershipGroups
  WHERE
    "wickets_down" >= 4
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "wickets_down"
)
SELECT
  PS."partnership_runs",
  P1."player_name",
  P2."player_name"
FROM PartnershipStats AS PS
JOIN "Players" AS P1
  ON PS."batsman1_id" = P1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS P2
  ON PS."batsman2_id" = P2."player_id"
ORDER BY
  PS."partnership_runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;

    FROM Deliveries d1

gold_sql:
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T2."season",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs",
  CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."extra_runs" = 0
      OR T1."runs_scored" > 0
      OR T1."wicket_type" IS NOT NULL THEN 1
    END
  ) AS "strike_rate"
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T3."player_name",
  T2."season"
HAVING
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 400
ORDER BY
  "strike_rate" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: ఏ టిములు ఒక సీజన్ లో 50 పరుగుల ఓపెనింగ్ స్టాండ్ చేయలేకపోయారు? టిములు, సంవత్సరం మరియు వాళ్ళ అన్నిటికన్నా పెద్ద ఓపెనింగ్ స్టాండ్ రాయండి.

WITH OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS opening_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      "match_id",
      "inning",
      MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery_id
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
      "match_id",
      "inning"
  ) AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery_id OR T2.first_wicket_delivery_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team"

  "year";
generated_sql:
WITH OpeningStands AS (
    SELECT 
        d.batting_team AS Team,
        m.season AS Year,
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team ORDER BY d.over_number, d.ball_number) AS cumulative_runs,
        d.striker_id,
        d.non_striker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team ORDER BY d.over_number, d.ball_number) AS ball_sequence
    FROM 
        Deliveries d
    JOIN 
        Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE 
        d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
),

FirstWicket AS (
    SELECT 
        Team,
        Year,
        match_id,
        inning,
        MAX(cumulative_runs) AS opening_stand
    FROM 
        OpeningStands
    WHERE 
        ball_sequence <= (
            SELECT MIN(ball_sequence) 
            FROM OpeningStands os2 
            WHERE os2.match_id = OpeningStands.match_id 
            AND os2.inning = OpeningStands.inning 
            AND (os2.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND os2.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field'))
        )
        OR (
            SELECT COUNT(*) 
            FROM OpeningStands os3 
            WHERE os3.match_id = OpeningStands.match_id 
            AND os3.inning = OpeningStands.inning 
            AND (os3.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND os3.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field'))
        ) = 0
    GROUP BY 
        Team, Year, match_id, inning
),

TeamMaxOpening AS (
    SELECT 
        Team,
        Year,
        MAX(opening_stand) AS Highest_Opening_Stand
    FROM 
        FirstWicket
    GROUP BY 
        Team, Year
)

SELECT 
    Team AS Team,
    Year AS Year,
    Highest_Opening_Stand AS "Highest Opening Stand"
FROM 
    TeamMaxOpening
WHERE 
    Highest_Opening_Stand < 50
ORDER BY 
    Team, Year;

question: List the teams that failed to have a 50 run opening stand in a season.List the teams,year and their highest opening stand for that season
gold_sql:
WITH OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS opening_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      "match_id",
      "inning",
      MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery_id
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
      "match_id",
      "inning"
  ) AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery_id OR T2.first_wicket_delivery_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team"
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Delhi Daredevils'
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Kings XI Punjab'
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Deccan Chargers'
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Royal Challengers Bangalore'
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T1."batting_team"
  END AS "team",
  T2."season" AS "year",
  MAX(T1."opening_runs") AS "highest_opening_stand"
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T1
JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
GROUP BY
  "team",
  "year"
HAVING
  MAX(T1."opening_runs") < 50
ORDER BY
  "team",
  "year";

question: IPL 2025 में आखिरी 5 ओवरों में सबसे ज़्यादा स्ट्राइक रेट (SR) (न्यूनतम 25 गेंदें)। टॉप 5 खिलाड़ियों की सूची उनके रन, खेली गई गेंदों और स्ट्राइक रेट के साथ बताएँ।

    SELECT 
        striker_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS TotalRuns,
        COUNT(*) AS BallsFaced
    FROM 
        Deliveries
    WHERE 
        season = '2025'
        AND over_number > 15
        AND wides = 0
        AND noballs = 0
    GROUP BY 
        striker_id

        COUNT(*) >= 25
)

question: List the top 5 players who have missed the most matches between 2 appearances for a franchise.
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerMatchDates AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T1."team_name",
    T2."match_date"
  FROM "PlayerInMatch" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), PlayerConsecutiveAppearances AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "team_name",
    "match_date",
    LEAD("match_date", 1) OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id", "team_name" ORDER BY "match_date") AS "next_match_date"
  FROM PlayerMatchDates
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T1."team_name",
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(T2."match_id")
    FROM "Matches" AS T2
    WHERE
      (
        T2."team1" = T1."team_name" OR T2."team2" = T1."team_name"
      )
      AND T2."match_date" > T1."match_date"
      AND T2."match_date" < T1."next_match_date"
  ) AS "missed_matches"
FROM PlayerConsecutiveAppearances AS T1
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."player_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1."next_match_date" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  "missed_matches" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: ఏ టాప్ 5 క్రీడాకార్లు 2 ఆటల మాజ్జిలో వాళ్ళ ఫ్రాంఛైజీ అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ ఆటలు ఆడింది?
gold_sql:
WITH FranchiseMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    CASE
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE "team_name"
    END AS "franchise_name"
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        "match_id",
        "team1" AS "team_name"
      FROM "Matches"
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        "match_id",
        "team2" AS "team_name"
      FROM "Matches"
    )
), FranchiseMatchNumbers AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "franchise_name",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "franchise_name" ORDER BY "match_id") AS "franchise_match_seq"
  FROM FranchiseMatches
), PlayerAppearanceSequence AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."franchise_name",
    T2."franchise_match_seq"
  FROM "PlayerInMatch" AS T1
  JOIN FranchiseMatchNumbers AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."franchise_name" = CASE
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE T1."team_name"
    END
), AppearanceGaps AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "franchise_name",
    "franchise_match_seq" - LAG("franchise_match_seq", 1) OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id", "franchise_name" ORDER BY "franchise_match_seq") AS "gap"
  FROM PlayerAppearanceSequence
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."franchise_name",
  T4."gap" - 1 AS "matches_missed"
FROM AppearanceGaps AS T4
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T4."player_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T4."gap" > 1
ORDER BY
  "matches_missed" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: ऐसे 5 खिलाड़ियों की सूची बनाएँ, जिनके दो मैचों में खेलने के बीच उनकी टीम ने सबसे ज़्यादा मैच खेले हों।
gold_sql:
WITH FranchiseMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    CASE
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE "team_name"
    END AS "franchise_name"
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        "match_id",
        "team1" AS "team_name"
      FROM "Matches"
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        "match_id",
        "team2" AS "team_name"
      FROM "Matches"
    )
), FranchiseMatchNumbers AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "franchise_name",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "franchise_name" ORDER BY "match_id") AS "franchise_match_seq"
  FROM FranchiseMatches
), PlayerAppearanceSequence AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."franchise_name",
    T2."franchise_match_seq"
  FROM "PlayerInMatch" AS T1
  JOIN FranchiseMatchNumbers AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."franchise_name" = CASE
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE T1."team_name"
    END
), AppearanceGaps AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "franchise_name",
    "franchise_match_seq" - LAG("franchise_match_seq", 1) OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id", "franchise_name" ORDER BY "franchise_match_seq") AS "gap"
  FROM PlayerAppearanceSequence
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."franchise_name",
  T4."gap" - 1 AS "matches_missed"
FROM AppearanceGaps AS T4
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T4."player_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T4."gap" > 1
ORDER BY
  "matches_missed" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: top 4 Highest partnership average in ipl with minimum 1000 runs.
gold_sql:
WITH PartnershipDeliveries AS (
  SELECT
    MIN("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p1_id,
    MAX("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p2_id,
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    "player_out_id",
    "wicket_type"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), PartnershipStats AS (
  SELECT
    p1_id,
    p2_id,
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS total_runs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IN (p1_id, p2_id) AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') THEN 1 END) AS dismissals
  FROM PartnershipDeliveries
  GROUP BY
    p1_id,
    p2_id
)
SELECT
  p1."player_name",
  p2."player_name",
  CAST(ps.total_runs AS REAL) / ps.dismissals AS "Partnership Average"
FROM PartnershipStats AS ps
JOIN "Players" AS p1
  ON ps.p1_id = p1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS p2
  ON ps.p2_id = p2."player_id"
WHERE
  ps.total_runs >= 1000 AND ps.dismissals > 0
ORDER BY
  "Partnership Average" DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: IPL లో అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ పార్ట్నర్షిప్ ఆవెరేజ్ ఉన్న 4 జతలు (కనీసం 1000 పరుగులు) ఏమిటి?
gold_sql:
WITH PartnershipDeliveries AS (
  SELECT
    MIN("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p1_id,
    MAX("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p2_id,
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    "player_out_id",
    "wicket_type"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), PartnershipStats AS (
  SELECT
    p1_id,
    p2_id,
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS total_runs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IN (p1_id, p2_id) AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') THEN 1 END) AS dismissals
  FROM PartnershipDeliveries
  GROUP BY
    p1_id,
    p2_id
)
SELECT
  p1."player_name",
  p2."player_name",
  CAST(ps.total_runs AS REAL) / ps.dismissals AS "Partnership Average"
FROM PartnershipStats AS ps
JOIN "Players" AS p1
  ON ps.p1_id = p1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS p2
  ON ps.p2_id = p2."player_id"
WHERE
  ps.total_runs >= 1000 AND ps.dismissals > 0
ORDER BY
  "Partnership Average" DESC
LIMIT 4;

        d.striker_id, 
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.striker_id = pim.player_id
    WHERE pim.team_name = 'LSG'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id
), Partners AS (
    SELECT 
        lb1.match_id, 
        lb1.inning, 
        lb1.striker_id AS Partner1, 
        lb2.striker_id AS Partner2, 
        lb1.runs_scored + lb2.runs_scored AS PartnershipRuns
    FROM LSG_Batting lb1
    JOIN LSG_Batting lb2 
    ON lb1.match_id = lb2.match_id AND lb1.inning = lb2.inning
    WHERE lb1.striker_id < lb2.striker_id
), RankedPartners AS (
    SELECT 
        Partner1, 
        Partner2, 
        PartnershipRuns,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY PartnershipRuns DESC) AS rn
    FROM Partners
)
SELECT 
    p1.player_name AS "Partner 1", 
    p2.player_name AS "Partner 2", 
    rp.PartnershipRuns AS "Partnership Runs"
FROM RankedPartners rp
JOIN Players p1 ON rp.Partner1 = p1.player_id
JOIN Players p2 ON rp.Partner2 = p2.player_id
WHERE rp.rn = 1;

question: LSG ਲਈ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਿਕਟ ਜਾਂ ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਹੇਠਾਂ ਲਈ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੀ ਸਾਂਝੇਦਾਰੀ।
gold_sql:
WITH PartnershipData AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored" + "extra_runs" AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS wicket_group
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "batting_team" = 'Lucknow Super Giants'
), PartnershipPairs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    wicket_group,
    MIN("striker_id") AS p1_id,
    MAX("striker_id") AS p2_id,
    SUM(total_runs) AS partnership_runs
  FROM PartnershipData
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    wicket_group
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  T3."player_name",
  T1.partnership_runs
FROM PartnershipPairs AS T1
JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1.p1_id = T2."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1.p2_id = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.wicket_group >= 1
ORDER BY
  T1.partnership_runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: the 3 batsmen to Reach 50 in 25 or fewer balls most times in a season
gold_sql:
WITH BatsmanInnings AS (

    T1."match_id",

    T2."season",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        T1."match_id",
        T1."striker_id"
      ORDER BY
        T1."inning",
        T1."over_number",
        T1."ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(
      CASE WHEN NOT (
        T1."extra_runs" > 0
        AND T1."runs_scored" = 0
        AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        T1."match_id",
        T1."striker_id"
      ORDER BY
        T1."inning",
        T1."over_number",
        T1."ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_balls_faced"
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), BallsToFifty AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "season",
    MIN("cumulative_balls_faced") AS "balls_taken"
  FROM BatsmanInnings
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 50

    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "season"
), FastFifties AS (

    "striker_id",
    "season"
  FROM BallsToFifty

    SELECT 
        m.season AS Season,
        m.team1 AS Team,
        m.match_date,
        CASE WHEN m.match_winner = m.team1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS won
    FROM Matches m
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        m.season AS Season,
        m.team2 AS Team,
        m.match_date,
        CASE WHEN m.match_winner = m.team2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS won
    FROM Matches m

    FROM TeamMatchResults

    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN match_num <= 4 AND won = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 4

        m.season AS Season,

            WHEN m.stage LIKE '%Final%' THEN m.team2

            WHEN m.stage LIKE '%Qualifier%' THEN m.team2

            WHEN m.stage LIKE '%Eliminator%' THEN m.team2

SELECT

  T1."bowling_team",
  T2."venue"
FROM Deliveries AS T1

  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."batting_team" = 'Mumbai Indians' AND T1."over_number" >= 18

  T1."inning"

gold_answer: ["(51, 'Delhi Capitals', 'Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai')", "(48, 'Delhi Capitals', 'Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai')", "(45, 'Chennai Super Kings', 'Wankhede Stadium')", "(44, 'Kings XI Punjab', 'Sheikh Zayed Stadium')", "(42, 'Delhi Daredevils', 'Wankhede Stadium')"]

    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team,

question: किसी भी विपक्षी टीम के खिलाफ सबसे ज़्यादा औसत किस खिलाड़ी का है? (न्यूनतम 500 रन)। रन, स्ट्राइक रेट और औसत भी बताएं।
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", CASE WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru' ELSE T1."bowling_team" END AS "opponent", SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1."extra_runs" > 0 AND T1."runs_scored" = 0 AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS "average" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" GROUP BY T2."player_name", "opponent" HAVING SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 500 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) > 0 ORDER BY "average" DESC LIMIT 1
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS 'Player Name',
    d.bowling_team AS 'Opponent',
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS 'Total Runs',
    ROUND((SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0) / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END), 2) AS 'Strike Rate',
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE NULL END), 2) AS 'Average'
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE 
    d.runs_scored > 0
GROUP BY 
    d.striker_id, d.bowling_team
HAVING 
    SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 500
ORDER BY 
    'Average' DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: किसी एक विपक्षी टीम के खिलाफ किसी खिलाड़ी का सर्वोच्च बल्लेबाजी औसत, जिसने उस टीम के खिलाफ कम से कम 500 रन बनाए हों। रन, स्ट्राइक रेट और औसत की सूची दें।
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", CASE WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru' ELSE T1."bowling_team" END AS "opponent", SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1."extra_runs" > 0 AND T1."runs_scored" = 0 AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS "average" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" GROUP BY T2."player_name", "opponent" HAVING SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 500 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) > 0 ORDER BY "average" DESC LIMIT 1
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerOpponentStats AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_name AS Player_Name,
        CASE
            WHEN d.bowling_team = m.team1 THEN m.team2
            ELSE m.team1
        END AS Opponent,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Total_Runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS Balls_Faced,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) AS Matches_Played
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY p.player_name, Opponent
)
SELECT
    Player_Name,
    Opponent,
    Total_Runs,
    ROUND((Total_Runs * 1.0 / Balls_Faced) * 100, 2) AS Strike_Rate,
    ROUND(Total_Runs * 1.0 / Matches_Played, 2) AS Average
FROM PlayerOpponentStats
WHERE Total_Runs >= 500
ORDER BY Average DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: मुंबई इंडियंस के खिलाफ केएल राहुल के कुल रन, स्ट्राइक रेट और औसत बताएं।
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(T2."runs_scored"), CAST(SUM(T2."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T2."extra_runs" > 0 AND T2."runs_scored" = 0 AND T2."wicket_type" IS NULL) THEN 1 END), CAST(SUM(T2."runs_scored") AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."player_out_id" = T1."player_id" AND T2."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) FROM Players AS T1 INNER JOIN Deliveries AS T2 ON T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id" WHERE T1."player_name" LIKE 'KL Rahul%' AND T2."bowling_team" = 'Mumbai Indians'
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(runs_scored) AS "Total Runs",
    ROUND((SUM(runs_scored) * 100.0) / COUNT(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 END), 2) AS "Strike Rate", 
    ROUND(SUM(runs_scored) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END), 2) AS "Batting Average"
FROM Deliveries
JOIN Matches ON Deliveries.match_id = Matches.match_id
JOIN Players ON Deliveries.striker_id = Players.player_id
WHERE Players.player_name = 'KL Rahul' AND (Matches.team1 = 'Mumbai Indians' OR Matches.team2 = 'Mumbai Indians');

question: MI వ్యతిరేకంగా KL Rahul యొక్క పరుగులు, స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ మరియు ఆవెరేజ్ ఏమిటి?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(T2."runs_scored"), CAST(SUM(T2."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T2."extra_runs" > 0 AND T2."runs_scored" = 0 AND T2."wicket_type" IS NULL) THEN 1 END), CAST(SUM(T2."runs_scored") AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."player_out_id" = T1."player_id" AND T2."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) FROM Players AS T1 INNER JOIN Deliveries AS T2 ON T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id" WHERE T1."player_name" LIKE 'KL Rahul%' AND T2."bowling_team" = 'Mumbai Indians'
generated_sql:
WITH KL_Rahul_Stats AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(runs_scored) AS Total_Runs,
        COUNT(*) AS Total_Balls,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS Total_Outs
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE striker_id = (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE player_name = 'KL Rahul')
      AND bowling_team = 'MI'
      AND wides = 0
      AND noballs = 0
)
SELECT 
    Total_Runs AS "Total Runs",
    ROUND((Total_Runs * 100.0) / Total_Balls, 2) AS "Strike Rate",
    ROUND(Total_Runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(Total_Outs, 0), 2) AS "Batting Average"
FROM KL_Rahul_Stats;

question: ਇੱਕ IPL ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ ਵਾਲੇ ਚੋਟੀ ਦੇ 4 ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ (ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 100 ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਖੇਡੀਆਂ ਹੋਣ)
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T2.player_name,
  T3.season,
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS "StrikeRate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
GROUP BY
  T2.player_name,
  T3.season
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) >= 100
ORDER BY
  "StrikeRate" DESC
LIMIT 4;
generated_sql:

       ROUND(SUM(D.runs_scored) * 100.0 / COUNT(D.ball_number), 2) AS 'Strike Rate'
FROM Deliveries D
JOIN Players P ON D.striker_id = P.player_id
JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id
WHERE D.wides = 0 AND D.noballs = 0
GROUP BY P.player_id, M.season
HAVING COUNT(D.ball_number) >= 100
ORDER BY 'Strike Rate' DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: Top 4 Highest SR for a batter in an IPL season (min. 100 balls faced)
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T2.player_name,
  T3.season,
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS "StrikeRate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
GROUP BY
  T2.player_name,
  T3.season
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) >= 100
ORDER BY
  "StrikeRate" DESC
LIMIT 4;
generated_sql:
WITH BatterStats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        m.season,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced
    FROM 
        Deliveries d
    JOIN 
        Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN 
        Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY 
        p.player_name, m.season
    HAVING 
        balls_faced >= 100
)
SELECT 
    player_name AS "Player Name",
    season AS "Season",
    ROUND((total_runs * 100.0 / balls_faced), 2) AS "Strike Rate"
FROM 
    BatterStats
ORDER BY 
    "Strike Rate" DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: ఒక IPL సీజన్లో ఒక బ్యాట్స్మ్యాన్ యొక్క టాప్ 4 అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఏమిటి (కనీసం 100 బంతులను ఎదురుకున్నాడు)?
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T2.player_name,
  T3.season,
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS "StrikeRate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
GROUP BY
  T2.player_name,
  T3.season
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) >= 100
ORDER BY
  "StrikeRate" DESC
LIMIT 4;
generated_sql:
WITH BatsmanStats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name AS Player_Name,
        m.season AS Season,
        COUNT(d.ball_number) AS BallsFaced,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS RunsScored
    FROM 
        Deliveries d
        JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
        JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE 
        d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY 
        p.player_name, m.season
    HAVING 
        BallsFaced >= 100
)
SELECT 
    Player_Name, 
    Season, 
    ROUND((CAST(RunsScored AS REAL) / BallsFaced) * 100, 2) AS Strike_Rate
FROM 
    BatsmanStats
ORDER BY 
    Strike_Rate DESC, RunsScored DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: list the number of times each team has chased a total of 200 or more.
gold_sql:
WITH Inning1Scores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "inning1_total"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
), ChasingTeams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T1.match_winner
  END AS "team_name",
  COUNT(T1.match_id) AS "successful_chases"
FROM Matches AS T1
JOIN Inning1Scores AS T2
  ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
JOIN ChasingTeams AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
WHERE
  T1.match_winner = T3.batting_team AND T2.inning1_total >= 199
GROUP BY
  "team_name"
ORDER BY
  "successful_chases" DESC;
gold_answer: ["('Punjab Kings', 8)", "('Mumbai Indians', 5)", "('Sunrisers Hyderabad', 4)", "('Rajasthan Royals', 4)", "('Chennai Super Kings', 4)", "('Royal Challengers Bengaluru', 3)", "('Lucknow Super Giants', 3)", "('Kolkata Knight Riders', 3)", "('Delhi Capitals', 3)", "('Gujarat Titans', 2)"]
generated_sql:
SELECT team_name AS `Team Name`, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS `Successful Chases`
FROM PlayerInMatch pim
JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN (
    SELECT match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM Deliveries
    GROUP BY match_id, inning
) d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE pim.team_name = m.match_winner 
AND d.inning = 2 
AND d.total_runs >= 200
GROUP BY pim.team_name;

question: LSG के लिए 100+ रनों की सभी ओपनिंग साझेदारियों की सूची दें, जिसमें कुल रन और शामिल बल्लेबाज़ों के नाम भी बताएं।
gold_sql:
WITH FirstWicket AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery_id
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
), OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS partnership_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN FirstWicket AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T2.first_wicket_delivery_id IS NULL
    OR T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery_id
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team"
), OpeningBatsmen AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "delivery_id" IN (
      SELECT
        MIN("delivery_id")
      FROM "Deliveries"
      GROUP BY
        "match_id",
        "inning"
    )
)
SELECT
  T1.partnership_runs,
  T3."player_name",
  T4."player_name"
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T1
INNER JOIN OpeningBatsmen AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T2."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T2."non_striker_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.batting_team = 'Lucknow Super Giants' AND T1.partnership_runs >= 100
ORDER BY
  T1.partnership_runs DESC;

JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE m.season = '2025'
AND (m.team1 = 'Rajasthan Royals' OR m.team2 = 'Rajasthan Royals')
AND (m.team1 = 'Sunrisers Hyderabad' OR m.team2 = 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
AND p.player_name = 'TM Head'
AND d.inning = CASE WHEN d.batting_team = m.team1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
AND d.wides = 0
AND d.noballs = 0
AND (
    SELECT SUM(runs_scored) 
    FROM Deliveries d2 
    WHERE d2.match_id = d.match_id 
    AND d2.striker_id = d.striker_id 
    AND (d2.inning < d.inning OR (d2.inning = d.inning AND d2.over_number < d.over_number) OR (d2.inning = d.inning AND d2.over_number = d.over_number AND d2.ball_number <= d.ball_number))
) >= 50
AND (
    SELECT SUM(runs_scored) 
    FROM Deliveries d3 
    WHERE d3.match_id = d.match_id 
    AND d3.striker_id = d.striker_id 
    AND (d3.inning < d.inning OR (d3.inning = d.inning AND d3.over_number < d.over_number) OR (d3.inning = d.inning AND d3.over_number = d.over_number AND d3.ball_number < d.ball_number))
) < 50;

question: list all instances of 100+ opening stands for lsg.the total runs and the batters involved
gold_sql:
WITH FirstWicket AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery_id
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
), OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS partnership_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN FirstWicket AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T2.first_wicket_delivery_id IS NULL
    OR T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery_id
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team"
), OpeningBatsmen AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "delivery_id" IN (
      SELECT
        MIN("delivery_id")
      FROM "Deliveries"
      GROUP BY
        "match_id",
        "inning"
    )
)
SELECT
  T1.partnership_runs,
  T3."player_name",
  T4."player_name"
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T1
INNER JOIN OpeningBatsmen AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T2."striker_id" = T3."player_id"

  T1.batting_team = 'Lucknow Super Giants' AND T1.partnership_runs >= 100

question: highest partnership to get a 10-wicket win in ipl
gold_sql:
WITH TenWicketWinMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "match_winner"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    "result_type" = 'wickets' AND "result_margin" = 10
), PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    SUM(T2."runs_scored" + T2."extra_runs") AS total_runs
  FROM TenWicketWinMatches AS T1
  JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."batting_team" = T1."match_winner"
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id"
), Partners AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T2."striker_id" AS player_id
  FROM TenWicketWinMatches AS T1
  JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."batting_team" = T1."match_winner"
  UNION
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T2."non_striker_id" AS player_id
  FROM TenWicketWinMatches AS T1
  JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."batting_team" = T1."match_winner"
)
SELECT
  T2."total_runs",
  GROUP_CONCAT(T4."player_name", ' and ') AS partnership_players
FROM Partners AS T1
JOIN PartnershipRuns AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_id" = T4."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T1."match_id"
ORDER BY
  T2."total_runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: IPL లో 10 విక్కెట్లతో గెలుపులో అన్నిటికన్నా పెద్ద భాగస్వామ్యం ఏమిటి?
gold_sql:
WITH TenWicketWinMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "match_winner"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    "result_type" = 'wickets' AND "result_margin" = 10
), PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    SUM(T2."runs_scored" + T2."extra_runs") AS total_runs
  FROM TenWicketWinMatches AS T1
  JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."batting_team" = T1."match_winner"
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id"
), Partners AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T2."striker_id" AS player_id
  FROM TenWicketWinMatches AS T1
  JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."batting_team" = T1."match_winner"
  UNION
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T2."non_striker_id" AS player_id
  FROM TenWicketWinMatches AS T1
  JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."batting_team" = T1."match_winner"
)
SELECT
  T2."total_runs",
  GROUP_CONCAT(T4."player_name", ' and ') AS partnership_players
FROM Partners AS T1
JOIN PartnershipRuns AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_id" = T4."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T1."match_id"
ORDER BY
  T2."total_runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: IPL ਵਿੱਚ 10 ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਜਿੱਤ ਦਰਜ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੀ ਸਾਂਝੇਦਾਰੀ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਹੈ?
gold_sql:
WITH TenWicketWinMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "match_winner"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    "result_type" = 'wickets' AND "result_margin" = 10
), PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    SUM(T2."runs_scored" + T2."extra_runs") AS total_runs
  FROM TenWicketWinMatches AS T1
  JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."batting_team" = T1."match_winner"
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id"
), Partners AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T2."striker_id" AS player_id
  FROM TenWicketWinMatches AS T1
  JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."batting_team" = T1."match_winner"
  UNION
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T2."non_striker_id" AS player_id
  FROM TenWicketWinMatches AS T1
  JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."batting_team" = T1."match_winner"
)
SELECT
  T2."total_runs",
  GROUP_CONCAT(T4."player_name", ' and ') AS partnership_players
FROM Partners AS T1
JOIN PartnershipRuns AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_id" = T4."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T1."match_id"
ORDER BY
  T2."total_runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH FirstWicket AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",

  LEFT JOIN FirstWicket AS T2

    OR FirstWicket.first_wicket_delivery IS NULL
  )
GROUP BY
  Deliveries.match_id,
  Deliveries.inning
ORDER BY
  partnership_runs DESC
LIMIT 2;

question: IPL 2025 में DC vs GT वाले मैच में KL Rahul की शतक वाली पारी हर 20 गेंदों के बाद कैसे आगे बढ़ी, यह दिखाओ।
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "runs_scored",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      ORDER BY
        "over_number",
        "ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_balls_faced",
    SUM("runs_scored") OVER (
      ORDER BY
        "over_number",
        "ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_runs_scored"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "striker_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" LIKE 'KL Rahul%'
    ) AND "match_id" = (
      SELECT
        T1."match_id"
      FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
      INNER JOIN "Players" AS T2
        ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
      INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
        ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
      WHERE
        T2."player_name" LIKE 'KL Rahul%' AND T3."season" = '2025' AND (
          (
            (
              CASE
                WHEN T3."team1" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
                THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
                ELSE T3."team1"
              END
            ) = 'Delhi Capitals' AND T3."team2" = 'Gujarat Titans'
          ) OR (
            T3."team1" = 'Gujarat Titans' AND (
              CASE
                WHEN T3."team2" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
                THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
                ELSE T3."team2"
              END
            ) = 'Delhi Capitals'
          )
        )
      GROUP BY
        T1."match_id"
      HAVING
        SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 100
      LIMIT 1
    )
)
SELECT
  MAX("cumulative_balls_faced") AS "balls_faced",
  MAX("cumulative_runs_scored") AS "runs_scored"
FROM PlayerInnings
WHERE
  "cumulative_balls_faced" > 0
GROUP BY
  ("cumulative_balls_faced" - 1) / 20
ORDER BY
  "balls_faced";
generated_sql:
WITH KL_Rahul_Deliveries AS (
    SELECT d.runs_scored
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    WHERE m.season = '2025'
      AND m.team1 = 'DC' AND m.team2 = 'GT'
      AND p.player_name = 'KL Rahul'
      AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
), Aggregated AS (
    SELECT 
        (ROW_NUMBER() OVER ()) * 20 AS Balls_Faced,
        SUM(runs_scored) OVER (ORDER BY ROW_NUMBER() ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS Runs_Scored
    FROM KL_Rahul_Deliveries
)
SELECT Balls_Faced, Runs_Scored
FROM Aggregated
WHERE Balls_Faced % 20 = 0 OR Balls_Faced = (SELECT MAX(Balls_Faced) FROM AggregATED);

question: एक IPL सीज़न में किसी जोड़ी द्वारा 50 से ज़्यादा रनों की सबसे ज़्यादा सलामी साझेदारियाँ।
gold_sql:
WITH FirstWicket AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
), OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS partnership_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN FirstWicket AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery OR T2.first_wicket_delivery IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning"
), OpeningPairs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS player1_id,
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "non_striker_id" ELSE "striker_id" END AS player2_id
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0 AND "ball_number" = 1
)
SELECT
  T5."player_name",
  T6."player_name",
  T4."season",
  COUNT(T3."match_id") AS num_50_plus_stands
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T3
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T4
  ON T3."match_id" = T4."match_id"
INNER JOIN OpeningPairs AS T7
  ON T3."match_id" = T7."match_id"
  AND T3."inning" = T7."inning"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T5
  ON T7.player1_id = T5."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T6
  ON T7.player2_id = T6."player_id"
WHERE
  T3.partnership_runs > 50
GROUP BY
  T4."season",
  T5."player_name",
  T6."player_name"
ORDER BY
  num_50_plus_stands DESC
LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH PartnershipRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        d1.match_id,
        d1.inning,
        d1.striker_id AS player1_id,
        d1.non_striker_id AS player2_id,
        SUM(d1.runs_scored + d2.runs_scored) AS partnership_runs,
        m.season
    FROM 
        Deliveries d1
    JOIN 
        Deliveries d2 ON d1.match_id = d2.match_id 
        AND d1.inning = d2.inning 
        AND d1.over_number = d2.over_number 
        AND d1.ball_number = d2.ball_number
    JOIN 
        Matches m ON d1.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE 
        d1.striker_id <> d2.striker_id 
        AND d1.wides = 0 
        AND d1.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY 
        d1.match_id, d1.inning, d1.striker_id, d1.non_striker_id, m.season
    HAVING 
        partnership_runs > 50
),
PartnershipCount AS (
    SELECT 
        player1_id,
        player2_id,
        season,
        COUNT(*) AS NumberOf50PlusStands
    FROM 
        PartnershipRuns
    GROUP BY 
        player1_id, player2_id, season
),
FinalPartners AS (
    SELECT 
        p1.player_name AS "Player 1 Name",

    FROM 
        PartnershipCount pc
    JOIN 
        Players p1 ON pc.player1_id = p1.player_id
    JOIN 
        Players p2 ON pc.player2_id = p2.player_id
)
