question: ఒక IPL సీజన్లో ఏ జంట అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ 50+ పరుగుల ఓపెనింగ్ భాగస్వామ్యాలు చేశారు?
gold_sql:
WITH FirstWicket AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
), OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS partnership_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN FirstWicket AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery OR T2.first_wicket_delivery IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning"
), OpeningPairs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS player1_id,
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "non_striker_id" ELSE "striker_id" END AS player2_id
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0 AND "ball_number" = 1
)
SELECT
  T5."player_name",
  T6."player_name",
  T4."season",
  COUNT(T3."match_id") AS num_50_plus_stands
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T3
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T4
  ON T3."match_id" = T4."match_id"
INNER JOIN OpeningPairs AS T7
  ON T3."match_id" = T7."match_id"
  AND T3."inning" = T7."inning"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T5
  ON T7.player1_id = T5."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T6
  ON T7.player2_id = T6."player_id"
WHERE
  T3.partnership_runs > 50
GROUP BY
  T4."season",
  T5."player_name",
  T6."player_name"
ORDER BY
  num_50_plus_stands DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH OpeningPairs AS (
    SELECT 
        d1.striker_id AS player1_id,
        d1.non_striker_id AS player2_id,
        m.season,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d1.match_id) AS partnership_count
    FROM Deliveries d1
    JOIN Matches m ON d1.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d1.over_number = 1 AND d1.ball_number = 1
    GROUP BY d1.striker_id, d1.non_striker_id, m.season
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d1.match_id) >= 1
),
PairRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        op.player1_id,
        op.player2_id,
        op.season,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
        op.partnership_count
    FROM OpeningPairs op
    JOIN Deliveries d ON (
        (d.striker_id = op.player1_id AND d.non_striker_id = op.player2_id) OR
        (d.striker_id = op.player2_id AND d.non_striker_id = op.player1_id)
    ) AND d.match_id IN (
        SELECT match_id 
        FROM Deliveries 
        WHERE (striker_id = op.player1_id AND non_striker_id = op.player2_id AND over_number = 1 AND ball_number = 1) OR
              (striker_id = op.player2_id AND non_striker_id = op.player1_id AND over_number = 1 AND ball_number = 1)
    )
    GROUP BY op.player1_id, op.player2_id, op.season
),
FiftyPlusStands AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.player1_id,
        pr.player2_id,
        pr.season,
        COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus_stands
    FROM PairRuns pr
    WHERE pr.total_runs >= 50
    GROUP BY pr.player1_id, pr.player2_id, pr.season
),
MaxStands AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        MAX(fifty_plus_stands) AS max_stands
    FROM FiftyPlusStands
    GROUP BY season
)
SELECT 
    p1.player_name AS "Player 1 Name",
    p2.player_name AS "Player 2 Name",
    fs.season AS "Season",
    fs.fifty_plus_stands AS "Number of 50+ Stands"
FROM FiftyPlusStands fs
JOIN MaxStands ms ON fs.season = ms.season AND fs.fifty_plus_stands = ms.max_stands
JOIN Players p1 ON fs.player1_id = p1.player_id
JOIN Players p2 ON fs.player2_id = p2.player_id
ORDER BY fs.fifty_plus_stands DESC;

gold_sql:
WITH DefeatCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "season",
    CASE
      WHEN "toss_decision" = 'field' THEN "toss_winner"
      WHEN "toss_winner" = "team1" THEN "team2"
      ELSE "team1"
    END AS chasing_team,
    "match_winner"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    "match_winner" IS NOT NULL
), SeasonDefeats AS (
  SELECT
    "season",
    chasing_team,
    COUNT(*) AS num_defeats
  FROM DefeatCounts
  WHERE
    chasing_team <> "match_winner"
  GROUP BY
    "season",
    chasing_team
)
SELECT
  chasing_team,
  "season",
  num_defeats
FROM SeasonDefeats
WHERE
  num_defeats = (
    SELECT
      MAX(num_defeats)
    FROM SeasonDefeats
  )
ORDER BY
  "season";

question: IPL 2025 ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸੇ ਟੀਮ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਬਣਾਏ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਤੇਜ਼ 50 ਰਨ|
gold_sql:
WITH MatchProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 AND "noballs" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_legal_balls"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), FiftyMilestones AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    "cumulative_legal_balls",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "cumulative_legal_balls") AS "rn"
  FROM MatchProgress
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 50
)
SELECT
  T2."batting_team",
  T2."cumulative_legal_balls" AS "balls_to_reach_50"
FROM "Matches" AS T1
INNER JOIN FiftyMilestones AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."season" = '2025' AND T2."rn" = 1
ORDER BY
  "balls_to_reach_50" ASC
LIMIT 1;

        SUM(runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, batting_team ORDER BY delivery_id) AS cumulative_runs,

    FROM 
        Deliveries

        season = '2025'

    MIN(ball_count) AS 'Balls to Reach 50'

    batting_team

question: IPL 2025 యొక్క అన్నిటికన్నా వేగమైన టీం 50 ఏమిటి?
gold_sql:
WITH MatchProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 AND "noballs" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_legal_balls"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), FiftyMilestones AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    "cumulative_legal_balls",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "cumulative_legal_balls") AS "rn"
  FROM MatchProgress
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 50
)
SELECT
  T2."batting_team",
  T2."cumulative_legal_balls" AS "balls_to_reach_50"
FROM "Matches" AS T1
INNER JOIN FiftyMilestones AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."season" = '2025' AND T2."rn" = 1
ORDER BY
  "balls_to_reach_50" ASC
LIMIT 1;

            SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) OVER (

)
GROUP BY batting_team

question: list bowling stats of Fazalhaq Farooqi in IPL 2025
gold_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.wides + T1.noballs) AS "Runs Conceded",
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND T1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
      THEN 1
    END
  ) AS "Wickets",
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) / 6 AS TEXT) || '.' || CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) % 6 AS TEXT) AS "Overs Bowled",
  (SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.wides + T1.noballs) * 6.0) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "Economy Rate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.bowler_id = T2.player_id
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
WHERE
  T2.player_name LIKE 'Fazalhaq Farooqi%' AND T3.season = '2025';
generated_sql:
WITH LegalDeliveries AS (
    SELECT 
        d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs AS runs_conceded,
        CASE 
            WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS wicket,
        d.match_id,
        d.over_number,
        d.bowler_id
    FROM 
        Deliveries d
    LEFT JOIN 
        Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE 
        d.bowler_id = (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE player_name = 'Fazalhaq Farooqi') AND m.season = '2025' AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
),
BowlingStats AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(runs_conceded) AS Runs_Conceded,
        SUM(wicket) AS Wickets,
        COUNT(DISTINCT (match_id || '.' || over_number)) AS Overs_Bowled
    FROM 
        LegalDeliveries
)
SELECT 
    Runs_Conceded,
    Wickets,
    Overs_Bowled,
    CAST(Runs_Conceded AS REAL) / NULLIF(Overs_Bowled, 0) AS Economy_Rate
FROM 
    BowlingStats;

question: fastest team fifty in ipl 2025
gold_sql:
WITH MatchProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 AND "noballs" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_legal_balls"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), FiftyMilestones AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    "cumulative_legal_balls",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "cumulative_legal_balls") AS "rn"
  FROM MatchProgress
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 50
)
SELECT
  T2."batting_team",
  T2."cumulative_legal_balls" AS "balls_to_reach_50"
FROM "Matches" AS T1
INNER JOIN FiftyMilestones AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."season" = '2025' AND T2."rn" = 1
ORDER BY
  "balls_to_reach_50" ASC
LIMIT 1;

FROM "Deliveries" AS T1

  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "striker_id",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning", "batting_team" ORDER BY MIN("delivery_id")) AS "batting_position"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "striker_id"
) AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  AND T1."batting_team" = T2."batting_team"
  AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"

question: 5 Highest totals after being 3 down for < 35 in an IPL innings
gold_sql:
WITH InningsProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "wickets_down",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "current_score"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), QualifyingInnings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  FROM InningsProgress
  WHERE
    "wickets_down" = 3 AND "current_score" < 35
)
SELECT
  T2."batting_team",
  SUM(T2."runs_scored" + T2."extra_runs") AS "final_total"
FROM QualifyingInnings AS T1
JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
GROUP BY
  T1."match_id",
  T1."inning",
  T2."batting_team"
ORDER BY
  "final_total" DESC
LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: ["('Punjab Kings', 219)", "('Lucknow Super Giants', 213)", "('Delhi Capitals', 211)", "('Kolkata Knight Riders', 208)", "('Kolkata Knight Riders', 205)"]
generated_sql:
WITH InningTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        batting_team,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM 
        Deliveries
    GROUP BY 
        match_id, inning, batting_team
),
ThreeDownWickets AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        inning,
        COUNT(*) AS wickets
    FROM 
        Deliveries
    WHERE 
        wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
        AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY 
        match_id, inning
    HAVING 
        wickets >= 3
),
ThreeDownUnder35 AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.batting_team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_at_3_down
    FROM 
        Deliveries d
    JOIN 
        ThreeDownWickets t
    ON 
        d.match_id = t.match_id AND d.inning = t.inning
    GROUP BY 
        d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team
    HAVING 
        runs_at_3_down < 35
)
SELECT 
    t.batting_team AS 'Batting Team',
    i.total_runs AS 'Final Total Runs'
FROM 
    ThreeDownUnder35 t
JOIN 
    InningTotals i
ON 
    t.match_id = i.match_id AND t.inning = i.inning AND t.batting_team = i.batting_team
ORDER BY 
    i.total_runs DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: ఒక IPL మ్యాచ్లో 4 నుంచి 7 నెంబర్ బ్యాట్స్మెన్ల మొత్తం పరుగులు ఎప్పుడు అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ ఉన్నది?
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T3."venue",
  T1."batting_team",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs"
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "striker_id",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning", "batting_team" ORDER BY MIN("delivery_id")) AS "batting_position"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "striker_id"
) AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  AND T1."batting_team" = T2."batting_team"
  AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T2."batting_position" BETWEEN 4 AND 7
GROUP BY
  T1."match_id",
  T1."inning",
  T1."batting_team"
ORDER BY
  "total_runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT
    M.venue AS Venue,
    D.batting_team AS [Batting Team],
    SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS [Total Runs]
FROM
    Deliveries D
JOIN
    Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id
WHERE
    D.inning IN (1, 2) AND
    D.striker_id IN (
        SELECT player_id
        FROM PlayerInMatch
        WHERE match_id = D.match_id AND team_name = D.batting_team
        ORDER BY player_id
        LIMIT 4 OFFSET 3
    )
GROUP BY
    M.match_id, D.batting_team
ORDER BY
    [Total Runs] DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: *CSK द्वारा 180+ के लक्ष्य का सफलतापूर्वक पीछा किए गए मैचों की सूची बनाएं। इसमें टीम, लक्ष्य और साल का उल्लेख करें।**
gold_sql:
WITH FirstInningScores AS (

    "match_id",

  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T1."team1" = 'Chennai Super Kings' THEN CASE
      WHEN T1."team2" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
      WHEN T1."team2" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
      WHEN T1."team2" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      WHEN T1."team2" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
      WHEN T1."team2" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE T1."team2"
    END
    ELSE CASE
      WHEN T1."team1" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
      WHEN T1."team1" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
      WHEN T1."team1" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      WHEN T1."team1" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
      WHEN T1."team1" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE T1."team1"
    END
  END AS opponent_team,
  T2.first_inning_total + 1 AS target,
  T1."season"
FROM "Matches" AS T1
INNER JOIN FirstInningScores AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"

  T1."match_winner" = 'Chennai Super Kings' AND T1."result_type" = 'wickets' AND T2.first_inning_total >= 179;

question: ఒక IPL ఇన్నింగ్స్లో 35 పరుగులు కన్నా తక్కువ ఉన్నప్పుడు 3 వికెట్లు పడిన తర్వాత 5 అన్నిటికన్నా పెద్ద తోటల్స్ ఏమిటి?
gold_sql:
WITH InningsProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "wickets_down",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "current_score"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), QualifyingInnings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  FROM InningsProgress
  WHERE
    "wickets_down" = 3 AND "current_score" < 35
)
SELECT
  T2."batting_team",
  SUM(T2."runs_scored" + T2."extra_runs") AS "final_total"
FROM QualifyingInnings AS T1
JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
GROUP BY
  T1."match_id",
  T1."inning",
  T2."batting_team"
ORDER BY
  "final_total" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: 75 रन या उससे कम के स्कोर पर पहले 5 विकेट गंवाने के बाद, सफलतापूर्वक हासिल किए गए 3 सबसे बड़े लक्ष्यों की सूची दें। टीमों, लक्ष्य (target) और वर्ष का भी उल्लेख करें।
gold_sql:
WITH WicketFallInfo AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" <> 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS wicket_count
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
), FifthWicketScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    MIN(cumulative_score) AS score_at_5th_wicket
  FROM WicketFallInfo
  WHERE
    wicket_count = 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
), Targets AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") + 1 AS target
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T3."match_winner"
  END AS "winning_team",
  T2.target,
  T3."season"
FROM FifthWicketScores AS T1
JOIN Targets AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T1.score_at_5th_wicket <= 75 AND T1."batting_team" = T3."match_winner"
ORDER BY
  T2.target DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: ਪਹਿਲੀਆਂ 5 ਵਿਕਟਾਂ 75 ਜਾਂ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ ਰੰਨਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਗੁਆਉਣ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਪਿੱਛਾ ਕੀਤੇ ਗਏ 3 ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੇ targets ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦਿਓ; ਟੀਮਾਂ, target ਅਤੇ ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
gold_sql:
WITH WicketFallInfo AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" <> 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS wicket_count
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
), FifthWicketScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    MIN(cumulative_score) AS score_at_5th_wicket
  FROM WicketFallInfo
  WHERE
    wicket_count = 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
), Targets AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") + 1 AS target
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T3."match_winner"
  END AS "winning_team",
  T2.target,
  T3."season"
FROM FifthWicketScores AS T1
JOIN Targets AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T1.score_at_5th_wicket <= 75 AND T1."batting_team" = T3."match_winner"
ORDER BY
  T2.target DESC
LIMIT 3;
generated_sql:
WITH FirstFiveWickets AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team,
        m.season,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_at_five_wickets,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS wickets
    FROM 
        Deliveries d
    JOIN 
        Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY 
        d.match_id, d.batting_team, m.season
    HAVING 
        wickets >= 5 AND runs_at_five_wickets <= 75
),
TargetScores AS (
    SELECT 
        m.team1 AS team,
        m.team2 AS opponent,
        m.season,
        m.match_winner AS Winning_Team,
        (SELECT SUM(d2.runs_scored) 
         FROM Deliveries d2 
         WHERE d2.match_id = m.match_id AND d2.batting_team = m.team1) AS target_score
    FROM 
        Matches m
    JOIN 
        FirstFiveWickets ffw ON m.match_id = ffw.match_id AND m.team2 = ffw.batting_team
    WHERE 
        m.match_winner = m.team1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        m.team2 AS team,
        m.team1 AS opponent,
        m.season,
        m.match_winner AS Winning_Team,
        (SELECT SUM(d2.runs_scored) 
         FROM Deliveries d2 
         WHERE d2.match_id = m.match_id AND d2.batting_team = m.team2) AS target_score
    FROM 
        Matches m
    JOIN 
        FirstFiveWickets ffw ON m.match_id = ffw.match_id AND m.team1 = ffw.batting_team
    WHERE 
        m.match_winner = m.team2
)
SELECT 
    Winning_Team AS "Winning Team",
    target_score AS "Target Score",
    season AS "Season"
FROM 
    TargetScores
ORDER BY 
    target_score DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: Of the matches that were played for 20 overs, list the two highest powerplay score by a team losing five or more wickets in Powerplay in IPL.list the teams, runs in pp, the opponent and the year.
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T1."batting_team",
  T1."powerplay_runs",
  CASE
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = T2."team1"
    THEN T2."team2"
    ELSE T2."team1"
  END AS "opponent",
  T2."season"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "powerplay_runs"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" <= 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
  HAVING
    COUNT("player_out_id") >= 5
) AS T1
JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."match_id" IN (
    SELECT
      "match_id"
    FROM "Deliveries"
    GROUP BY
      "match_id"
    HAVING
      MAX("over_number") >= 19
  )
ORDER BY
  T1."powerplay_runs" DESC
LIMIT 2;
gold_answer: ["('Rajasthan Royals', 62, 'Mumbai Indians', '2025')", "('Chennai Super Kings', 62, 'Kolkata Knight Riders', '2025')"]
generated_sql:

FROM 
    Deliveries d1
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d1.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE 
    d1.inning IN (1, 2)
    AND d1.over_number <= 6
    AND m.season LIKE 'IPL%'
GROUP BY

HAVING 
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)

            AND d2.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')

    'Powerplay Runs' DESC
LIMIT 2;

question: ਆਪਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੀ IPL ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ (ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 10 ਗੇਂਦਾਂ) ਵਾਲਾ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਕੌਣ ਹੈ ।
gold_sql:
WITH DebutInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    MIN("match_id") AS debut_match_id
  FROM PlayerInMatch
  GROUP BY
    "player_id"
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  SUM(T2."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate
FROM DebutInnings AS T1
JOIN Deliveries AS T2
  ON T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id" AND T1."debut_match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN Players AS T3
  ON T1."player_id" = T3."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T1."player_id"
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 10
ORDER BY
  strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS "Player Name", 
       ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END), 2) AS "Strike Rate"
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE d.inning = 1
GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) >= 10
ORDER BY "Strike Rate" DESC
LIMIT 1;

gold_sql:
WITH DebutMatches AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T1."match_id",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."player_id" ORDER BY T2."match_date") AS rn
  FROM "PlayerInMatch" AS T1
  JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), BattingStats AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS player_score,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
    SUM("runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T3."team1" || ' vs ' || T3."team2" AS teams,
  T2.player_score,
  T2.balls_faced,
  T3."season"
FROM DebutMatches AS T1

  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id"
JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"

question: ਪਲੇਇੰਗ ਇਲੈਵਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਵਾਰ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਦੇ 5 ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ (ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 10 ਗੇਂਦਾਂ)। ਖਿਡਾਰੀ, ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਦਾ ਸਕੋਰ, ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
gold_sql:
WITH DebutMatches AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T1."match_id",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."player_id" ORDER BY T2."match_date") AS rn
  FROM "PlayerInMatch" AS T1
  JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), BattingStats AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS player_score,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
    SUM("runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T3."team1" || ' vs ' || T3."team2" AS teams,
  T2.player_score,
  T2.balls_faced,
  T3."season"
FROM DebutMatches AS T1
JOIN BattingStats AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id"
JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.rn = 1 AND T2.balls_faced >= 10
ORDER BY
  T2.strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT p.player_name AS "Player Name", 
       m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 AS "Match Teams", 
       SUM(d.runs_scored) AS "Player Score", 
       COUNT(*) AS "Balls Faced", 
       m.season AS "Season"
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id AND m.match_id = pim.match_id
WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
  AND p.player_id IN (
    SELECT player_id
    FROM PlayerInMatch
    GROUP BY player_id
    HAVING min(match_id) = m.match_id
  )
GROUP BY p.player_id, m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.season
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0) / COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: list all instances of a team losing both its openers for nought.list the teams, openers and the year
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T3."season",
  T1."batting_team",
  T4."player_name",
  T5."player_name"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    "striker_id" AS opener1,
    "non_striker_id" AS opener2
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0 AND "ball_number" = 1
) AS T1
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1.opener1 = T4."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T5
  ON T1.opener2 = T5."player_id"
WHERE
  (
    SELECT
      SUM("runs_scored")
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "match_id" = T1."match_id" AND "striker_id" = T1.opener1
  ) = 0
  AND (
    SELECT
      SUM("runs_scored")
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "match_id" = T1."match_id" AND "striker_id" = T1.opener2
  ) = 0
  AND T1.opener1 IN (
    SELECT
      "player_out_id"
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "match_id" = T1."match_id"
  )
  AND T1.opener2 IN (
    SELECT
      "player_out_id"
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "match_id" = T1."match_id"
  );

gold_sql:
SELECT
  T3."season",
  T1."batting_team",
  T4."player_name",
  T5."player_name"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    "striker_id" AS opener1,
    "non_striker_id" AS opener2
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0 AND "ball_number" = 1
) AS T1
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1.opener1 = T4."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T5
  ON T1.opener2 = T5."player_id"
WHERE
  (
    SELECT
      SUM("runs_scored")
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "match_id" = T1."match_id" AND "striker_id" = T1.opener1
  ) = 0
  AND (
    SELECT
      SUM("runs_scored")
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "match_id" = T1."match_id" AND "striker_id" = T1.opener2
  ) = 0
  AND T1.opener1 IN (
    SELECT
      "player_out_id"
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "match_id" = T1."match_id"
  )
  AND T1.opener2 IN (
    SELECT
      "player_out_id"
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "match_id" = T1."match_id"
  );

question: list the 5 highest strike rates of a player with minimum 10 balls played in their debut ipl match.give the player, their runs and balls in that match, teams in that match, and year
gold_sql:
WITH DebutMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    MIN("match_id") AS debut_match_id
  FROM PlayerInMatch
  GROUP BY
    "player_id"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "runs",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "balls_faced",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate",
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN DebutMatches AS DM
  ON T1."striker_id" = DM."player_id" AND T1."match_id" = DM.debut_match_id
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
GROUP BY
  T2."player_name",
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 10
ORDER BY
  "strike_rate" DESC
LIMIT 5;

    m.match_id AS "Match ID",
    p.player_name AS "Player Name",
    m.team1 AS "Team 1",
    m.team2 AS "Team 2",
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS "Player Score",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "Balls Faced",
    m.season AS "Season"
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE 
    p.player_name LIKE '%wright%' AND 
    (m.team1 = 'Pune' OR m.team2 = 'Pune')
GROUP BY 
    m.match_id, p.player_id
ORDER BY 
    m.match_id;

question: अपने IPL डेब्यू मैच में कम से कम 10 गेंदें खेलने वाले, सबसे ज़्यादा स्ट्राइक रेट वाले 5 खिलाड़ियों की सूची दें। उस मैच में खिलाड़ी का नाम, उनके रन और गेंदें, दोनों टीमें और साल भी बताएं।
gold_sql:
WITH DebutMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    MIN("match_id") AS debut_match_id
  FROM PlayerInMatch
  GROUP BY
    "player_id"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "runs",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "balls_faced",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate",
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN DebutMatches AS DM
  ON T1."striker_id" = DM."player_id" AND T1."match_id" = DM.debut_match_id
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
GROUP BY
  T2."player_name",
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 10
ORDER BY
  "strike_rate" DESC
LIMIT 5;

gold_sql: SELECT T2."match_id", T3."player_name", T2."team1", T2."team2", SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "player_score", COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "balls_faced", T2."season" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" INNER JOIN Players AS T3 ON T1."striker_id" = T3."player_id" WHERE T3."player_name" LIKE '%Wright' AND T1."batting_team" = 'Pune Warriors' GROUP BY T1."match_id", T3."player_name" ORDER BY T2."match_date"

        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS PlayerScore,
        COUNT(*) AS BallsFaced,
        m.season

        Deliveries d

    BallsFaced AS "Balls Faced", 
    season AS "Season"
FROM 
    WrightBatting;

question: IPL డెబ్యూ మ్యాచ్లో కనీసం 10 బంతులు ఆడిన అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఉన్న 5 క్రీడాకార్లు ఎవరు? ఆ మ్యాచ్లో క్రీడాకారి పేరు, పరుగులు మరియు బంతులు, ఇద్దరి టీముల పేరులు మరియు సంవత్సరం రాయండి.
gold_sql:
WITH DebutMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    MIN("match_id") AS debut_match_id
  FROM PlayerInMatch
  GROUP BY
    "player_id"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "runs",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "balls_faced",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate",
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN DebutMatches AS DM
  ON T1."striker_id" = DM."player_id" AND T1."match_id" = DM.debut_match_id
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
GROUP BY
  T2."player_name",
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 10
ORDER BY
  "strike_rate" DESC
LIMIT 5;

    p.player_name AS 'Player Name',
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS 'Total Runs',
    COUNT(*) AS 'Balls Faced',
    ROUND((SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) * 100), 2) AS 'Strike Rate',
    m.team1 AS 'Team 1',
    m.team2 AS 'Team 2',
    m.season AS 'Season'
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
JOIN

JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id AND m.match_id = pim.match_id
WHERE 
    pim.match_id = (
        SELECT MIN(match_id)
        FROM PlayerInMatch
        WHERE player_id = p.player_id
    )
    AND d.wides = 0
    AND d.noballs = 0
    AND p.player_id IN (
        SELECT striker_id
        FROM Deliveries
        WHERE match_id = m.match_id
        GROUP BY striker_id
        HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
    )
GROUP BY 
    p.player_id
ORDER BY 
    'Strike Rate' DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: IPL में अपनी पहली पारी (डेब्यू) में कम से कम 10 गेंदें खेलने वाले उन 5 बल्लेबाज़ों की सूची दें जिनका स्ट्राइक रेट सबसे ज़्यादा रहा हो। साथ में खिलाड़ी का नाम, उस मैच में उनके रन और गेंदें, मैच की टीमें और साल भी बताएं।
gold_sql:
WITH DebutInning AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    MIN("match_date") AS debut_date
  FROM "Deliveries"
  JOIN "Matches"
    ON "Deliveries"."match_id" = "Matches"."match_id"
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  SUM(T2."runs_scored") AS runs,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
FROM DebutInning AS T1
JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T2."match_id" = T3."match_id"
  AND T1.debut_date = T3."match_date"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."striker_id" = T4."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T1."striker_id",
  T2."match_id"
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 10
ORDER BY
  SUM(T2."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: give the players who did not hit a boundary in the first 20 balls of their innings in ipl 2025.give the player name and their score in that match
gold_sql:
WITH RankedBalls AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."runs_scored",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T1."inning", T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS ball_faced_num
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."season" = '2025' AND T1."wides" = 0
), NoBoundaryInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
  FROM RankedBalls
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
  HAVING
    MAX(ball_faced_num) >= 20
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN ball_faced_num <= 20 AND "runs_scored" IN (4, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS score_in_match
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN NoBoundaryInnings AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4

question: *IPL 2025 में उन खिलाड़ियों के नाम और उस मैच में उनके स्कोर बताएं, जिन्होंने अपनी पारी की पहली 20 गेंदों में एक भी बाउंड्री नहीं लगाई।**
gold_sql:
WITH RankedBalls AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."runs_scored",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T1."inning", T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS ball_faced_num
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."season" = '2025' AND T1."wides" = 0
), NoBoundaryInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
  FROM RankedBalls
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
  HAVING
    MAX(ball_faced_num) >= 20
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN ball_faced_num <= 20 AND "runs_scored" IN (4, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS score_in_match
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN NoBoundaryInnings AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."striker_id" = T4."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T4."player_name",
  T1."match_id"
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS 'Player Name',
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS 'Score in Match'
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE 
    m.season = '2025'
    AND d.match_id IN (
        SELECT 
            d2.match_id
        FROM 
            Deliveries d2
        WHERE 
            d2.striker_id = p.player_id
            AND d2.match_id = d.match_id
        GROUP BY 
            d2.match_id, d2.striker_id
        HAVING 
            SUM(CASE WHEN d2.runs_scored IN (4, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
            AND COUNT(DISTINCT d2.over_number * 100 + d2.ball_number) <= 20
    )
GROUP BY 
    p.player_id, d.match_id
HAVING 
    SUM(d.runs_scored) > 0;

question: ਉਹਨਾਂ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੱਸੋ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ IPL 2025 ਵਿੱਚ ਆਪਣੀ ਪਾਰੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਪਹਿਲੀਆਂ 20 ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਊਂਡਰੀ (ਚੌਕਾ ਜਾਂ ਛੱਕਾ) ਨਹੀਂ ਮਾਰੀ। ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਮੈਚ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਸਦੇ ਸਕੋਰ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦਿਓ ।
gold_sql:
WITH RankedBalls AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."runs_scored",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T1."inning", T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS ball_faced_num
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."season" = '2025' AND T1."wides" = 0
), NoBoundaryInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
  FROM RankedBalls
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
  HAVING
    MAX(ball_faced_num) >= 20
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN ball_faced_num <= 20 AND "runs_scored" IN (4, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS score_in_match
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN NoBoundaryInnings AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."striker_id" = T4."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T4."player_name",
  T1."match_id"

SELECT p.player_name AS "Player Name", 
       SUM(d.runs_scored) AS "Score in Match"
FROM Players p
JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season = '2025'
  AND d.match_id IN (
      SELECT MIN(d2.match_id)
      FROM Deliveries d2
      WHERE d2.striker_id = p.player_id
        AND d2.inning IN (1, 2)
  )

        SUM(runs_scored) AS Runs,

    GROUP BY striker_id, bowler_id

question: give the lowest powerplay scores of ipl 2025.give the teams involved in the match, powerplay score with wickets and the city.(consider the matches that were played complete)
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T1."team1",
  T1."team2",
  T2."batting_team",
  T2.pp_runs || '/' || T2.pp_wickets AS powerplay_score,
  T1."city"
FROM Matches AS T1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS pp_runs,
    COUNT("player_out_id") AS pp_wickets

question: IPL 2025 లో అన్నిటికన్నా తక్కువ పవర్ప్లే స్కోర్ ఏమిటి? మ్యాచ్లో ఉన్న టిములు, విక్కెట్ల తో పాటు పవర్ప్లే స్కోర్ మరియు నగర రాయండి. మొత్తం ఆడిన మ్యాచులనే రాయండి.
gold_sql:
SELECT
  T1."team1",
  T1."team2",
  T2."batting_team",
  T2.pp_runs || '/' || T2.pp_wickets AS powerplay_score,
  T1."city"
FROM Matches AS T1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS pp_runs,
    COUNT("player_out_id") AS pp_wickets
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    "over_number" <= 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
) AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."season" = '2025' AND T1."result_type" IN ('runs', 'wickets')
ORDER BY
  pp_runs ASC,
  pp_wickets DESC
LIMIT 5;

generated_sql:
WITH PowerplayScores AS (
    SELECT
        m.match_id,
        m.team1 AS Team1,
        m.team2 AS Team2,
        d.batting_team AS BattingTeam,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS PowerplayScore,
        m.city AS City
    FROM
        Matches m
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE
        m.season = 'IPL 2025'
        AND d.inning IN (1, 2)
        AND d.over_number <= 6
        AND d.wides = 0
        AND d.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY
        m.match_id, d.batting_team
),
MinPowerplayScore AS (
    SELECT MIN(PowerplayScore) AS MinScore
    FROM PowerplayScores
)
SELECT
    ps.Team1 AS "Team 1",
    ps.Team2 AS "Team 2",
    ps.BattingTeam AS "Batting Team",
    ps.PowerplayScore AS "Powerplay Score",
    ps.City AS City
FROM
    PowerplayScores ps
JOIN MinPowerplayScore mps ON ps.PowerplayScore = mps.MinScore;

SELECT
  "match_date",
  (
    CASE
      WHEN "team1" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      ELSE "team1"
    END
  ) AS team1_name,
  (
    CASE
      WHEN "team2" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      ELSE "team2"
    END
  ) AS team2_name,
  "result_type",
  "result_margin"
FROM "Matches"
WHERE
  "city" = 'Dharamsala' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', "match_date") AS INTEGER) >= 2012 AND (
    CASE
      WHEN "match_winner" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      ELSE "match_winner"
    END
  ) = 'Punjab Kings'
ORDER BY
  "match_date";

question: first mi batter to be dismissed run out in 2025
gold_sql: SELECT T3."player_name" FROM Matches AS T1 INNER JOIN Deliveries AS T2 ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id INNER JOIN Players AS T3 ON T2.player_out_id = T3.player_id WHERE T1.season = '2025' AND T2.batting_team = 'Mumbai Indians' AND T2.wicket_type = 'run out' ORDER BY T1.match_date, T2.inning, T2.over_number, T2.ball_number LIMIT 1
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS "Player Name"
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.player_out_id = p.player_id
WHERE m.season = '2025'
  AND d.wicket_type = 'run out'
  AND d.batting_team = 'Mumbai Indians'

LIMIT 1;

question: LSG ਲਈ ਨੰਬਰ 5 ਜਾਂ ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਹੇਠਾਂ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਬਣਾਏ ਗਏ 50 ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਕੋਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerAppearances AS (
  SELECT
    "delivery_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  UNION
  SELECT
    "delivery_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "non_striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), FirstAppearance AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("delivery_id") AS first_delivery
  FROM PlayerAppearances
  GROUP BY
    "player_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning"
), BattingPositions AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY first_delivery) AS position
  FROM FirstAppearance
), PlayerRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS total_runs
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T3."total_runs",
  T5."venue",
  T5."match_date"
FROM BattingPositions AS T1
JOIN PlayerRuns AS T3
  ON T1."player_id" = T3."striker_id" AND T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_id" = T4."player_id"
JOIN "Matches" AS T5
  ON T1."match_id" = T5."match_id"
WHERE
  T3."batting_team" = 'Lucknow Super Giants' AND T1."position" >= 5 AND T3."total_runs" >= 50
ORDER BY
  T3."total_runs" DESC;

WITH PlayerAppearances AS (
  SELECT
    "delivery_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  UNION
  SELECT
    "delivery_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "non_striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), FirstAppearance AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("delivery_id") AS first_delivery
  FROM PlayerAppearances
  GROUP BY
    "player_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning"
), BattingPositions AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY first_delivery) AS position
  FROM FirstAppearance
), PlayerRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS total_runs
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
)

  T4."player_name",
  T3."total_runs",
  T5."venue",
  T5."match_date"

JOIN PlayerRuns AS T3

JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_id" = T4."player_id"
JOIN "Matches" AS T5
  ON T1."match_id" = T5."match_id"
WHERE
  T3."batting_team" = 'Lucknow Super Giants' AND T1."position" >= 5 AND T3."total_runs" >= 50
ORDER BY
  T3."total_runs" DESC;

question: ఇన్నింగ్స్ యొక్క చివరి ఓవర్లో Stoinis యొక్క బ్యాటింగ్ గణాంకాలు ఏమిటి? పరుగులు, బంతులు, అవుట్, స్ట్రైక్ రేట్, నాలుగులు మరియు ఆరులు ఇవ్వండి.
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS total_runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced, COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" THEN 1 END) AS dismissals, CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN T1."runs_scored" = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fours, SUM(CASE WHEN T1."runs_scored" = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sixes FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" WHERE T2."player_name" = 'MP Stoinis' AND T1."over_number" = 19
generated_sql:
WITH FinalOver AS (
    SELECT MAX(over_number) AS last_over
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE striker_id = (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE player_name = 'Stoinis')
)
SELECT
    p.player_name AS 'Player Name',
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS 'Total Runs',
    COUNT(d.delivery_id) AS 'Balls Faced',
    COUNT(d.wicket_type) AS 'Dismissals',
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / COUNT(d.delivery_id) * 100, 2) AS 'Strike Rate',
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Fours',
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Sixes'
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
JOIN FinalOver fo ON d.over_number = fo.last_over
WHERE p.player_name = 'Stoinis' AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY p.player_name;

question: ਪਾਰੀ ਦੇ ਆਖਰੀ ਓਵਰ ਵਿੱਚ Stoinis ਦੇ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਅੰਕੜੇ ਦੱਸੋ। ਰਨ, ਗੇਂਦਾਂ, ਵਿਕਟਾਂ, ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ, ਚੌਕੇ ਅਤੇ ਛੱਕਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦਿਓ ।
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS total_runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced, COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" THEN 1 END) AS dismissals, CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN T1."runs_scored" = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fours, SUM(CASE WHEN T1."runs_scored" = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sixes FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" WHERE T2."player_name" = 'MP Stoinis' AND T1."over_number" = 19

    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Dismissals',
    ROUND((SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS 'Strike Rate',

    )

question: सभी संस्करणों में किसी ओपनर द्वारा बनाए गए सबसे ज़्यादा लगातार 50+ स्कोर। खिलाड़ी का नाम, उनकी स्ट्रीक, उस स्ट्रीक में बनाए गए स्कोर, (विपक्षी) टीमें और साल बताएं। सबसे लंबी स्ट्रीक के सभी उदाहरणों की सूची दें।
gold_sql:
WITH OpenerInnings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "non_striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
), OpenerScores AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_id",
    T3."match_date",
    T3."season",
    T2."batting_team",
    SUM(T2."runs_scored") AS "runs"
  FROM OpenerInnings AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id"
    AND T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
    ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_id"
), RankedScores AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") AS inning_rank
  FROM OpenerScores
), StreakIdentifier AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    inning_rank - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") AS streak_group
  FROM RankedScores
  WHERE
    "runs" >= 50
), StreakDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    COUNT(*) AS "streak_count",
    GROUP_CONCAT("runs", ', ') AS "scores",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT "batting_team") AS "teams",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT SUBSTR("season", 1, 4)) AS "years"
  FROM StreakIdentifier

        p.player_name,
        d.match_id,
        m.season,

        CASE WHEN SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_fifty_plus
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d.inning = 1 AND d.over_number <= 6
    GROUP BY p.player_name, d.match_id, m.season, m.team1, m.team2
),

    SELECT 
        player_name,
        match_id,

        team1,
        team2,

question: the 2 highest partnerships for the sixth wicket or lower for RR in the IPL. list the partnership runs and the batters involved
gold_sql:
WITH WicketInfo AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning"
      ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number"
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
    ), 0) AS "partnership_group"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE "batting_team" = 'Rajasthan Royals'
),
PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "partnership_runs"
  FROM WicketInfo
  WHERE "partnership_group" >= 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group"
),
PartnershipPlayers AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    "player_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group", "striker_id" AS "player_id" FROM WicketInfo
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group", "non_striker_id" AS "player_id" FROM WicketInfo
  )
  WHERE "partnership_group" >= 5
),
PartnershipBatters AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."partnership_group",
    GROUP_CONCAT(T2."player_name", ', ') AS "batters"
  FROM PartnershipPlayers AS T1
  JOIN "Players" AS T2 ON T1."player_id" = T2."player_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."partnership_group"
)
SELECT
  T1."partnership_runs",
  T2."batters"
FROM PartnershipRuns AS T1
JOIN PartnershipBatters AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  AND T1."partnership_group" = T2."partnership_group"
ORDER BY
  T1."partnership_runs" DESC
LIMIT 2;
gold_answer: ["(92, 'R Parag, SO Hetmyer')", "(85, 'SPD Smith, JP Faulkner')"]
generated_sql:
WITH RRDeliveries AS (
    SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id, d.runs_scored, d.wicket_type, d.player_out_id, m.match_date
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE (m.team1 = 'RR' OR m.team2 = 'RR') AND d.batting_team = 'RR'
),
WicketFalls AS (
    SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS batsman_id, runs_scored, wicket_type, player_out_id, match_date,
           SUM(runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY match_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY match_date) AS fall_of_wicket
    FROM RRDeliveries
    WHERE wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
),
Partnerships AS (
    SELECT w1.match_id, w1.inning, w1.fall_of_wicket AS wicket_fall,
           COUNT(*) AS balls,
           SUM(d.runs_scored) AS partnership_runs,
           GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p1.player_name || ' & ' || p2.player_name) AS batters
    FROM WicketFalls w1
    JOIN WicketFalls w2 ON w1.match_id = w2.match_id AND w1.inning = w2.inning AND w1.fall_of_wicket = w2.fall_of_wicket - 1
    JOIN RRDeliveries d ON w1.match_id = d.match_id AND w1.inning = d.inning AND (d.striker_id = w1.batsman_id OR d.non_striker_id = w1.batsman_id)
    JOIN Players p1 ON w1.batsman_id = p1.player_id
    JOIN Players p2 ON w2.batsman_id = p2.player_id
    WHERE w1.fall_of_wicket >= 5
    GROUP BY w1.match_id, w1.inning, w1.fall_of_wicket
),
RankedPartnerships AS (
    SELECT partnership_runs, batters,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY partnership_runs DESC) AS rank
    FROM Partnerships
)
SELECT partnership_runs AS `Partnership Runs`, batters AS Batters
FROM RankedPartnerships
WHERE rank <= 2
ORDER BY `Partnership Runs` DESC
LIMIT 2;

question: *IPL में RR के लिए छठे विकेट या उससे नीचे की 2 सबसे बड़ी साझेदारियों की सूची दें। साझेदारी में बने रन और इसमें शामिल बल्लेबाजों के नाम बताएं।**
gold_sql:
WITH WicketInfo AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning"
      ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number"
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
    ), 0) AS "partnership_group"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE "batting_team" = 'Rajasthan Royals'
),
PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "partnership_runs"
  FROM WicketInfo
  WHERE "partnership_group" >= 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group"
),
PartnershipPlayers AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    "player_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group", "striker_id" AS "player_id" FROM WicketInfo
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group", "non_striker_id" AS "player_id" FROM WicketInfo
  )
  WHERE "partnership_group" >= 5
),
PartnershipBatters AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."partnership_group",
    GROUP_CONCAT(T2."player_name", ', ') AS "batters"
  FROM PartnershipPlayers AS T1
  JOIN "Players" AS T2 ON T1."player_id" = T2."player_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."partnership_group"
)
SELECT
  T1."partnership_runs",
  T2."batters"
FROM PartnershipRuns AS T1
JOIN PartnershipBatters AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  AND T1."partnership_group" = T2."partnership_group"
ORDER BY
  T1."partnership_runs" DESC
LIMIT 2;
gold_answer: ["(92, 'R Parag, SO Hetmyer')", "(85, 'SPD Smith, JP Faulkner')"]

WITH RR_Partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        d1.match_id,
        d1.inning,
        d1.striker_id AS batter1_id,
        d1.non_striker_id AS batter2_id,
        SUM(d1.runs_scored + d1.extra_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY d1.match_id, d1.inning ORDER BY d1.delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d1.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY d1.match_id, d1.inning ORDER BY d1.delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS wickets_fallen
    FROM Deliveries d1
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim1 ON d1.match_id = pim1.match_id AND d1.striker_id = pim1.player_id
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim2 ON d1.match_id = pim2.match_id AND d1.non_striker_id = pim2.player_id
    WHERE pim1.team_name = 'RR' OR pim2.team_name = 'RR'
),
RR_Filtered_Partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        inning,
        batter1_id,
        batter2_id,
        cumulative_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY cumulative_runs DESC) AS rn
    FROM RR_Partnerships
    WHERE wickets_fallen >= 5
)
SELECT 
    cumulative_runs AS `Partnership Runs`,
    p1.player_name || ' & ' || p2.player_name AS `Batters`
FROM RR_Filtered_Partnerships fp
JOIN Players p1 ON fp.batter1_id = p1.player_id
JOIN Players p2 ON fp.batter2_id = p2.player_id
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY `Partnership Runs` DESC;

question: IPL లో ఏ ఉదాహరణాలలో ఒక క్రీడాకారుడు ఒక టీం కి వ్యతిరేకంగా 50 కన్నా ఎక్కువ సిక్సులు కొట్టాడు?
gold_sql: SELECT T2."player_name", CASE WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant' WHEN T1."bowling_team" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru' ELSE T1."bowling_team" END AS "opponent_team", COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS "total_sixes" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id" WHERE T1."runs_scored" = 6 GROUP BY T2."player_name", "opponent_team" HAVING COUNT(T1."delivery_id") >= 50 ORDER BY "total_sixes" DESC

JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id

question: RCB కి వ్యతిరేకంగా CSK యొక్క అన్నిటికన్నా పెద్ద భాగస్వామ్యం (ఏ వికెట్ కి అయ్యిన) ఏమిటి?
gold_sql:
WITH MatchIDs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    (
      CASE "team1"
        WHEN 'Royal Challengers Bangalore' THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
        ELSE "team1"
      END = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru' AND "team2" = 'Chennai Super Kings'
    ) OR (
      "team1" = 'Chennai Super Kings' AND CASE "team2"
        WHEN 'Royal Challengers Bangalore' THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
        ELSE "team2"
      END = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    )
), PartnershipPeriods AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "partnership_group"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "match_id" IN (
      SELECT
        "match_id"
      FROM MatchIDs
    )
), PartnershipDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "partnership_group",
    "match_id",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS "p1_id",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "non_striker_id" ELSE "striker_id" END AS "p2_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "runs"
  FROM PartnershipPeriods
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    "p1_id",
    "p2_id"
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."player_name",
  T2."runs"
FROM PartnershipDetails AS T2
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T2."p1_id" = T3."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T2."p2_id" = T4."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T2."runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p1.player_name AS 'Player 1 Name',
    p2.player_name AS 'Player 2 Name',
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs - d.byes - d.legbyes) AS 'Partnership Runs'
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Players p1 ON d.striker_id = p1.player_id
JOIN 
    Players p2 ON d.non_striker_id = p2.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE 
    m.team1 IN ('CSK', 'RCB') AND m.team2 IN ('CSK', 'RCB')
    AND (
        (d.batting_team = 'CSK' AND m.team1 = 'RCB')
        OR (d.batting_team = 'CSK' AND m.team2 = 'RCB')
    )
GROUP BY 
    d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id
ORDER BY 
    'Partnership Runs' DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: CSK ਬਨਾਮ RCB ਦੇ ਮੈਚਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੀਆਂ ਸਾਂਝੇਦਾਰੀਆਂ (ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਵਿਕਟ ਲਈ)।
gold_sql:
WITH MatchIDs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    (
      CASE "team1"
        WHEN 'Royal Challengers Bangalore' THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
        ELSE "team1"
      END = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru' AND "team2" = 'Chennai Super Kings'
    ) OR (
      "team1" = 'Chennai Super Kings' AND CASE "team2"
        WHEN 'Royal Challengers Bangalore' THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
        ELSE "team2"
      END = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    )
), PartnershipPeriods AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "partnership_group"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "match_id" IN (
      SELECT
        "match_id"
      FROM MatchIDs
    )
), PartnershipDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "partnership_group",
    "match_id",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS "p1_id",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "non_striker_id" ELSE "striker_id" END AS "p2_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "runs"
  FROM PartnershipPeriods
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    "p1_id",
    "p2_id"
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."player_name",
  T2."runs"
FROM PartnershipDetails AS T2
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T2."p1_id" = T3."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T2."p2_id" = T4."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T2."runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH CSKvsRCB AS (
    SELECT match_id FROM Matches 
    WHERE (team1 = 'CSK' AND team2 = 'RCB') OR (team1 = 'RCB' AND team2 = 'CSK')
),
Partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        d1.match_id,
        p1.player_name AS player1_name,
        p2.player_name AS player2_name,
        SUM(d1.runs_scored + d1.extra_runs) AS partnership_runs,
        MIN(d1.over_number * 6 + d1.ball_number) AS start_ball,
        MAX(d1.over_number * 6 + d1.ball_number) AS end_ball
    FROM Deliveries d1
    JOIN Deliveries d2 ON d1.match_id = d2.match_id 
        AND d1.inning = d2.inning 
        AND d1.striker_id = d2.non_striker_id 
        AND d1.non_striker_id = d2.striker_id
        AND d1.delivery_id < d2.delivery_id
    JOIN Players p1 ON d1.striker_id = p1.player_id
    JOIN Players p2 ON d1.non_striker_id = p2.player_id
    JOIN CSKvsRCB ON d1.match_id = CSKvsRCB.match_id
    WHERE d1.wides = 0 AND d1.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY d1.match_id, d1.striker_id, d1.non_striker_id
)
SELECT 
    player1_name AS "Player 1 Name",
    player2_name AS "Player 2 Name",
    MAX(partnership_runs) AS "Partnership Runs"
FROM Partnerships
GROUP BY player1_name, player2_name
ORDER BY "Partnership Runs" DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: RCB के खिलाफ CSK की सबसे बड़ी साझेदारी (किसी भी विकेट के लिए)
gold_sql:
WITH MatchIDs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    (
      CASE "team1"
        WHEN 'Royal Challengers Bangalore' THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
        ELSE "team1"
      END = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru' AND "team2" = 'Chennai Super Kings'
    ) OR (
      "team1" = 'Chennai Super Kings' AND CASE "team2"
        WHEN 'Royal Challengers Bangalore' THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
        ELSE "team2"
      END = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    )
), PartnershipPeriods AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "partnership_group"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "match_id" IN (
      SELECT
        "match_id"
      FROM MatchIDs
    )
), PartnershipDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "partnership_group",
    "match_id",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS "p1_id",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "non_striker_id" ELSE "striker_id" END AS "p2_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "runs"
  FROM PartnershipPeriods
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    "p1_id",
    "p2_id"
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."player_name",
  T2."runs"
FROM PartnershipDetails AS T2
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T2."p1_id" = T3."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T2."p2_id" = T4."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T2."runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH CSKvsRCB AS (
    SELECT match_id 
    FROM Matches 
    WHERE (team1 = 'CSK' AND team2 = 'RCB') OR (team1 = 'RCB' AND team2 = 'CSK')
),
CSKBatters AS (
    SELECT d.match_id, d.striker_id AS player_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN CSKvsRCB m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d.batting_team = 'CSK'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id
),
Partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        d1.match_id,
        p1.player_name AS player1_name,
        p2.player_name AS player2_name,
        SUM(d1.runs_scored + d2.runs_scored + d1.extra_runs + d2.extra_runs) AS partnership_runs
    FROM Deliveries d1
    JOIN Deliveries d2 ON 
        d1.match_id = d2.match_id AND 
        d1.inning = d2.inning AND 
        d1.over_number = d2.over_number AND 
        d1.batting_team = d2.batting_team AND
        ((d1.striker_id = d2.striker_id AND d1.non_striker_id = d2.non_striker_id) OR 
         (d1.striker_id = d2.non_striker_id AND d1.non_striker_id = d2.striker_id))
    JOIN Players p1 ON p1.player_id = d1.striker_id
    JOIN Players p2 ON p2.player_id = d1.non_striker_id
    JOIN CSKvsRCB m ON d1.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d1.batting_team = 'CSK' AND d1.wides = 0 AND d1.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY d1.match_id, p1.player_name, p2.player_name
)
SELECT 
    player1_name AS "Player 1 Name",
    player2_name AS "Player 2 Name",
    MAX(partnership_runs) AS "Partnership Runs"
FROM Partnerships
GROUP BY player1_name, player2_name
ORDER BY "Partnership Runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: all instances for the Most consecutive 50-plus scores for RCB in the IPL
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerMatchScores AS (
  SELECT
    T1.striker_id,
    T2.match_date,
    SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS runs
  FROM Deliveries AS T1
  INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
  WHERE
    (CASE
      WHEN T1.batting_team IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE T1.batting_team
    END) = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
  GROUP BY
    T1.striker_id,
    T2.match_date
), FiftyPlusFlag AS (
  SELECT
    striker_id,
    match_date,
    (
      CASE
        WHEN runs >= 50
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS is_fifty_plus,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date) AS match_num
  FROM PlayerMatchScores
), StreakGroup AS (
  SELECT
    striker_id,
    (
      match_num - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date)
    ) AS streak_id
  FROM FiftyPlusFlag
  WHERE
    is_fifty_plus = 1
)
SELECT
  T2.player_name,
  COUNT(T1.striker_id) AS consecutive_fifties
FROM StreakGroup AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
GROUP BY
  T2.player_name,
  T1.streak_id
ORDER BY
  consecutive_fifties DESC
LIMIT 1;

    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id

),

        inning,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_match IS NULL OR prev_inning != inning THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS seq_start
    FROM 
        ConsecutiveFifties
),
GroupedSequences AS (
    SELECT
        striker_id,
        match_id,
        inning,

question: IPL में RCB के लिए सबसे ज़्यादा लगातार 50-प्लस स्कोर के सभी उदाहरण।
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerMatchScores AS (
  SELECT
    T1.striker_id,
    T2.match_date,
    SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS runs
  FROM Deliveries AS T1
  INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
  WHERE
    (CASE
      WHEN T1.batting_team IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE T1.batting_team
    END) = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
  GROUP BY
    T1.striker_id,
    T2.match_date
), FiftyPlusFlag AS (
  SELECT
    striker_id,
    match_date,
    (
      CASE
        WHEN runs >= 50
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS is_fifty_plus,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date) AS match_num
  FROM PlayerMatchScores
), StreakGroup AS (
  SELECT
    striker_id,
    (
      match_num - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date)
    ) AS streak_id
  FROM FiftyPlusFlag
  WHERE
    is_fifty_plus = 1
)
SELECT
  T2.player_name,
  COUNT(T1.striker_id) AS consecutive_fifties
FROM StreakGroup AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
GROUP BY
  T2.player_name,
  T1.streak_id
ORDER BY
  consecutive_fifties DESC
LIMIT 1;

    SELECT 
        striker_id,
        match_date,
        runs,

            WHEN runs >= 50 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_fifty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date) - 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id, CASE WHEN runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ORDER BY match_date) AS grp
    FROM PlayerScores
),
FilteredConsecutiveFifties AS (
    SELECT 
        striker_id,
        COUNT(*) AS ConsecutiveFifties
    FROM ConsecutiveFifties
    WHERE is_fifty = 1

    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

    FROM FilteredConsecutiveFifties

question: ਇੱਕ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ 4 ਜਾਂ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੁਆਰਾ 40+ ਰਨ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਮੌਕਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ; ਟੀਮਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦਿਓ ।
gold_sql:
WITH BatterScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id"
  HAVING
    SUM("runs_scored") >= 40
), InningsWith40Plus AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  FROM BatterScores
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  HAVING
    COUNT("striker_id") >= 4
)
SELECT
  T2."season",
  CASE
    WHEN T2."team1" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T2."team1" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T2."team1" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T2."team1" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T2."team1" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T2."team1"
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN T2."team2" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T2."team2" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T2."team2" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T2."team2" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T2."team2" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T2."team2"
  END
FROM InningsWith40Plus AS T1
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id";
gold_answer: ["('2011', 'Rajasthan Royals', 'Chennai Super Kings')", "('2023', 'Lucknow Super Giants', 'Punjab Kings')", "('2024', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad', 'Mumbai Indians')", "('2025', 'Mumbai Indians', 'Rajasthan Royals')"]

question: IPL లో వరుసగా అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ సార్లు 25+ స్కోర్ చేసిన 5 క్రీడాకార్లు ఎవరు? పేరు మరియు స్ట్రీక్ రాయండి.
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerMatchRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id" AS "player_id",
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS "runs"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "match_id"
), ScoresWithDate AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_date",
    CASE
      WHEN T1."runs" >= 25 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS "is_25plus"
  FROM PlayerMatchRuns AS T1
  JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), StreakIdentifier AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "is_25plus",
    (
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id", "is_25plus" ORDER BY "match_date")
    ) AS "streak_group"
  FROM ScoresWithDate
), StreakLengths AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    COUNT(*) AS "streak"
  FROM StreakIdentifier
  WHERE
    "is_25plus" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "player_id",
    "streak_group"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  T1."streak"
FROM StreakLengths AS T1
JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."player_id" = T2."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T1."streak" DESC
LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: ["('SA Yadav', 16)", "('RV Uthappa', 10)", "('SPD Smith', 9)", "('V Kohli', 9)", "('B Sai Sudharsan', 9)"]

    SELECT 
        p.player_name AS 'Player Name',
        d.match_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS match_runs
    FROM

    JOIN 
        Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    WHERE 
        d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY 
        p.player_name, d.match_id
),
Streaks AS (
    SELECT 
        player_name AS 'Player Name',
        match_id,
        match_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 25 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_name 
            ORDER BY match_id 
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS streak_group
    FROM 
        PlayerScores
),
StreakCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        'Player Name',
        streak_group,
        COUNT(*) AS streak_length
    FROM 
        Streaks
    WHERE 
        match_runs >= 25
    GROUP BY 
        'Player Name', streak_group
)
SELECT 
    s.'Player Name',
    MAX(sc.streak_length) AS '25+ Score Streak'
FROM 
    Streaks s
JOIN 
    StreakCounts sc ON s.'Player Name' = sc.'Player Name' AND s.streak_group = sc.streak_group
GROUP BY 
    s.'Player Name'
ORDER BY 
    '25+ Score Streak' DESC
LIMIT 5;

gold_answer: ["('A Mishra', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad', 'Pune', '2013')", "('YS Chahal', 'Rajasthan Royals', 'Mumbai', '2022')", "('AD Russell', 'Kolkata Knight Riders', 'Navi Mumbai', '2022')", "('YS Chahal', 'Punjab Kings', 'Chennai', '2025')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS 'Bowler Name',
    d.bowling_team AS 'Bowling Team',
    m.city AS 'City',
    m.season AS 'Season'
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
WHERE d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowler_id, (d.over_number + 1)
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) >= 4
ORDER BY m.season, m.city, d.bowling_team, p.player_name;

gold_sql: SELECT T3."player_name", T1."bowling_team", T2."city", T2."season" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" INNER JOIN Players AS T3 ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id" WHERE T1."wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') GROUP BY T1."match_id", T1."inning", T1."over_number", T1."bowler_id" HAVING count(*) = 4
gold_answer: ["('A Mishra', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad', 'Pune', '2013')", "('YS Chahal', 'Rajasthan Royals', 'Mumbai', '2022')", "('AD Russell', 'Kolkata Knight Riders', 'Navi Mumbai', '2022')", "('YS Chahal', 'Punjab Kings', 'Chennai', '2025')"]

WITH FourWicketsInOver AS (
    SELECT 
        d.bowler_id,
        d.bowling_team,

question: IPL में एक से ज़्यादा हैट्रिक लेने वाले 3 गेंदबाज़
gold_sql:
WITH WicketDeliveries AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id",
    "inning",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    CASE
      WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS "is_wicket"
  FROM "Deliveries"
),
SequencedWickets AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id",
    "is_wicket",
    LAG("is_wicket", 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "bowler_id" ORDER BY "inning", "over_number", "ball_number") AS "prev_is_wicket",
    LAG("is_wicket", 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "bowler_id" ORDER BY "inning", "over_number", "ball_number") AS "prev2_is_wicket"
  FROM WicketDeliveries
),
HatTricks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id"
  FROM SequencedWickets
  WHERE "is_wicket" = 1 AND "prev_is_wicket" = 1 AND "prev2_is_wicket" = 1
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name"
FROM HatTricks AS T1
JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T2."player_name"
HAVING
  COUNT(T1."match_id") > 1
ORDER BY
  COUNT(T1."match_id") DESC
LIMIT 3;

FROM Players p
WHERE p.player_id IN (

    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
    AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY bowler_id, match_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT over_number) >= 3
    GROUP BY bowler_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) > 1
)
LIMIT 3;

question: list all instances of CSK getting all-out at Chepauk in IPL

gold_sql:
WITH WicketDeliveries AS (

    "match_id",
    "bowler_id",
    "inning",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    CASE
      WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS "is_wicket"
  FROM "Deliveries"
),
SequencedWickets AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id",
    "is_wicket",

HatTricks AS (

question: IPL में 200+ का स्कोर सबसे कम ओवरों में चेज़ करने वाले टॉप 5 मैच बताएं, जिसमें टीमों, शहर और साल की जानकारी भी हो।
gold_sql:
WITH FirstInningsScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
  HAVING
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") >= 200
), SecondInningsChase AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 AND "noballs" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS legal_balls
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
)
SELECT
  M."team1",
  M."team2",
  M."city",
  SUBSTR(M."season", 1, 4) AS "year",
  (S."legal_balls" / 6) || '.' || (S."legal_balls" % 6) AS "overs_taken"
FROM "Matches" AS M
JOIN "FirstInningsScores" AS F
  ON M."match_id" = F."match_id"
JOIN "SecondInningsChase" AS S
  ON M."match_id" = S."match_id"
WHERE
  M."match_winner" = (
    SELECT
      "batting_team"
    FROM "Deliveries" AS D
    WHERE
      D."match_id" = M."match_id" AND D."inning" = 2
    LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY
  S."legal_balls" ASC
LIMIT 5;

WITH FirstInningsScores AS (

), SecondInningsChase AS (

    "match_id",

  FROM "Deliveries"

)

  M."team1",
  M."team2",
  M."city",
  SUBSTR(M."season", 1, 4) AS "year",
  (S."legal_balls" / 6) || '.' || (S."legal_balls" % 6) AS "overs_taken"
FROM "Matches" AS M

  ON M."match_id" = F."match_id"

  ON M."match_id" = S."match_id"

    SELECT
      "batting_team"
    FROM "Deliveries" AS D
    WHERE
      D."match_id" = M."match_id" AND D."inning" = 2
    LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY
