question: RR సాధించిన 200+ పరుగుల విజయవంతమైన చేసులు ఏమిటి?
gold_sql:
WITH FirstInningScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team" AS opponent,
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS first_inning_score
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
)
SELECT
  T1."season",
  T1."match_date",
  T1."venue",
  T2.opponent,
  T2.first_inning_score + 1 AS target
FROM "Matches" AS T1
INNER JOIN FirstInningScores AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."match_winner" = 'Rajasthan Royals' AND T1."match_winner" != T2.opponent AND T2.first_inning_score >= 200
ORDER BY
  T1."match_date" DESC;

question: IPL ਵਿੱਚ 200+ ਰਨ ਦੇ target ਦਾ ਪਿੱਛਾ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਲਏ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ ਓਵਰ। ਚੋਟੀ ਦੇ 5 ਮੈਚਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
gold_sql:
WITH FirstInningsScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
  HAVING
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") >= 200
), SecondInningsChase AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 AND "noballs" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS legal_balls
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
)
SELECT
  M."team1",
  M."team2",
  M."city",
  SUBSTR(M."season", 1, 4) AS "year",
  (S."legal_balls" / 6) || '.' || (S."legal_balls" % 6) AS "overs_taken"
FROM "Matches" AS M
JOIN "FirstInningsScores" AS F
  ON M."match_id" = F."match_id"
JOIN "SecondInningsChase" AS S
  ON M."match_id" = S."match_id"
WHERE
  M."match_winner" = (
    SELECT
      "batting_team"
    FROM "Deliveries" AS D
    WHERE
      D."match_id" = M."match_id" AND D."inning" = 2
    LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY
  S."legal_balls" ASC
LIMIT 5;

WITH TargetMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.team1 AS "Team 1",
        m.team2 AS "Team 2",
        m.city AS "City",
        m.season AS "Year",
        MAX(d.inning) AS innings_played,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.inning = 1 THEN d.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS team1_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.inning = 2 THEN d.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS team2_runs
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    GROUP BY m.match_id
    HAVING team1_runs >= 200 OR team2_runs >= 200
),
ChasingTeams AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.match_id,
        tm."Team 1",
        tm."Team 2",
        tm."City",
        tm."Year",
        CASE 
            WHEN tm.team1_runs > tm.team2_runs THEN tm."Team 1"
            ELSE tm."Team 2"
        END AS chasing_team,
        CASE 
            WHEN tm.team1_runs > tm.team2_runs THEN tm.team2_runs
            ELSE tm.team1_runs
        END AS target
    FROM TargetMatches tm
    WHERE (tm.team1_runs > tm.team2_runs AND tm.team2_runs >= 200)
       OR (tm.team2_runs > tm.team1_runs AND tm.team1_runs >= 200)
),
WinningDeliveries AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.match_id,
        ct."Team 1",
        ct."Team 2",
        ct."City",
        ct."Year",
        ct.chasing_team,
        ct.target,
        d.over_number,
        d.ball_number,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.over_number, d.ball_number) AS running_total
    FROM ChasingTeams ct
    JOIN Deliveries d ON ct.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE d.inning = 2 
      AND d.batting_team = ct.chasing_team
      AND d.wides = 0 
      AND d.noballs = 0
),
OversTaken AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        "Team 1",
        "Team 2",
        "City",
        "Year",
        MIN(over_number) + 1 AS "Overs Taken to Win"
    FROM WinningDeliveries
    WHERE running_total >= target
    GROUP BY match_id
)
SELECT 
    "Team 1",
    "Team 2",
    "City",
    "Year",
    "Overs Taken to Win"
FROM OversTaken
ORDER BY "Overs Taken to Win" ASC
LIMIT 5;

question: *अपने डेब्यू के बाद सबसे कम पारियों में शतक बनाने वाले खिलाड़ी का नाम, ली गई पारियों की संख्या, और शतक वाले मैच का स्कोर बताएं।**
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS "runs"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "match_id"
), RankedInnings AS (
  SELECT
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."runs",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T2."match_date") AS "inning_number"
  FROM PlayerInnings AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T3."inning_number",
  T3."runs"
FROM RankedInnings AS T3
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T3."striker_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T3."runs" >= 100 AND T3."inning_number" = (
    SELECT
      MIN("inning_number")
    FROM RankedInnings
    WHERE
      "runs" >= 100
  );

    SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100

question: highest partnership for any wicket for Rajasthan Royals.give the runs and players involved opposition and the year
gold_sql:
WITH PartnershipDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning"
      ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number"
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
    ), 0) AS partnership_group_id
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE "batting_team" = 'Rajasthan Royals'
),
PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS total_runs
  FROM PartnershipDetails
  GROUP BY "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group_id"
),
PartnershipPlayers AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group_id",
    "player_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group_id", "striker_id" AS player_id FROM PartnershipDetails
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group_id", "non_striker_id" AS player_id FROM PartnershipDetails
  )
),
FullPartnerships AS (
  SELECT
    pr."match_id",
    pr.total_runs,
    GROUP_CONCAT(p."player_name", ', ') AS players
  FROM PartnershipRuns AS pr
  JOIN PartnershipPlayers AS pp
    ON pr."match_id" = pp."match_id"
    AND pr."inning" = pp."inning"
    AND pr."partnership_group_id" = pp."partnership_group_id"
  JOIN "Players" AS p
    ON pp.player_id = p."player_id"
  GROUP BY
    pr."match_id",
    pr."inning",
    pr."partnership_group_id",
    pr.total_runs
  HAVING COUNT(pp.player_id) >= 2
)
SELECT
  fp.total_runs AS "runs",
  fp.players AS "players_involved",
  CASE
    WHEN m."team1" = 'Rajasthan Royals' THEN m."team2"
    ELSE m."team1"
  END AS "opposition",
  m."season" AS "year"
FROM FullPartnerships AS fp
JOIN "Matches" AS m
  ON fp."match_id" = m."match_id"
ORDER BY
  fp.total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team,
        d.striker_id,
        d.non_striker_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS TotalRuns
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d.batting_team = 'Rajasthan Royals' AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id
),
MaxPartnership AS (
    SELECT 
        rp.match_id,
        MAX(rp.TotalRuns) AS MaxRuns,
        rp.striker_id,

    FROM RajasthanPartnerships rp
    GROUP BY rp.match_id
)
SELECT 
    mp.MaxRuns AS `Total Runs`,
    p1.player_name || ' & ' || p2.player_name AS `Players Involved`,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.team1 = 'Rajasthan Royals' THEN m.team2 
        ELSE m.team1 
    END AS `Opposition`,
    SUBSTR(m.match_date, 1, 4) AS `Year`
FROM MaxPartnership mp
JOIN Matches m ON mp.match_id = m.match_id

question: *किसी खिलाड़ी द्वारा अपने डेब्यू के बाद शतक बनाने के लिए ली गई न्यूनतम पारियों की संख्या क्या है? खिलाड़ी का नाम, ली गई पारियां और शतक वाले मैच में उनका स्कोर भी सूचीबद्ध करें।**
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS "runs"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "match_id"
), RankedInnings AS (
  SELECT
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."runs",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T2."match_date") AS "inning_number"
  FROM PlayerInnings AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T3."inning_number",
  T3."runs"
FROM RankedInnings AS T3
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T3."striker_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T3."runs" >= 100 AND T3."inning_number" = (
    SELECT
      MIN("inning_number")
    FROM RankedInnings
    WHERE
      "runs" >= 100
  );

WITH PlayerDebuts AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(delivery_id) AS debut_delivery_id,
        striker_id AS player_id

PlayerCenturyMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        d.striker_id AS player_id,
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        COUNT(*) AS delivery_count,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN PlayerDebuts pd ON d.striker_id = pd.player_id AND d.delivery_id > pd.debut_delivery_id
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.inning
    HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100
),
PlayerInningsBeforeCentury AS (
    SELECT 
        pcm.player_id,
        COUNT(*) AS innings_before_century
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN PlayerCenturyMatches pcm ON d.match_id = pcm.match_id AND d.striker_id = pcm.player_id AND d.inning = pcm.inning
    JOIN PlayerDebuts pd ON d.striker_id = pd.player_id AND d.delivery_id > pd.debut_delivery_id
    GROUP BY pcm.player_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS `Player Name`,
    pcm.inning AS `Inning Number`,
    pcm.total_runs AS `Runs Scored`
FROM PlayerCenturyMatches pcm
JOIN PlayerInningsBeforeCentury pibc ON pcm.player_id = pibc.player_id
JOIN Players p ON pcm.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY pibc.innings_before_century ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: list all instances for fastest team 100 for rr.list the opposition and the year and the overs taken for the 100
gold_sql:
WITH MatchProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowling_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 AND "noballs" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "legal_deliveries_faced"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "batting_team" = 'Rajasthan Royals'
), FirstToHundred AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowling_team",
    MIN("legal_deliveries_faced") AS "balls_to_100"
  FROM MatchProgress
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 100
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "bowling_team"
)
SELECT
  T2."bowling_team" AS "opposition",
  T3."season" AS "year",
  (T2."balls_to_100" / 6) || '.' || (T2."balls_to_100" % 6) AS "overs_taken"
FROM FirstToHundred AS T2
JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T2."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T2."balls_to_100" = (
    SELECT
      MIN("balls_to_100")
    FROM FirstToHundred
  );

question: IPL లో 4 అన్నిటికన్నా వేగమైన శతాబ్దాలు (బంతులు ద్వారా) ఏమిటి? క్రీడాకారి పేరు, పరుగులు, వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం, నగరం మరియు సంవత్సరం రాయండి.
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS total_runs
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "match_id"
  HAVING
    SUM("runs_scored") >= 100
), CumulativeInnings AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."bowling_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS cumulative_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS balls_faced
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN PlayerInnings AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
), BallsTo100 AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "bowling_team",
    balls_faced,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "striker_id" ORDER BY balls_faced) AS rn
  FROM CumulativeInnings
  WHERE
    cumulative_runs >= 100
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T2.total_runs,
  T1.balls_faced,
  T1."bowling_team",
  T3."city",
  T3."season"
FROM BallsTo100 AS T1
JOIN PlayerInnings AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."striker_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.rn = 1
ORDER BY
  T1.balls_faced ASC
LIMIT 4;

    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS balls_faced
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN PlayerInnings AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
), BallsTo100 AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "bowling_team",
    balls_faced,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "striker_id" ORDER BY balls_faced) AS rn
  FROM CumulativeInnings
  WHERE
    cumulative_runs >= 100
)

  T1.balls_faced,

JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."striker_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.rn = 1
ORDER BY
  T1.balls_faced ASC
LIMIT 4;

question: RR అన్నిటికన్నా వేగంగా ఏ ఉదారహణాలలో 100 పరుగులు సంపాదించింది? ప్రతి మ్యాచ్ కోసం వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం, సంవత్సరం మరియు 100 పరుగులు సంపాదించడానికి ఓవర్లు రాయండి.
gold_sql:
WITH MatchProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowling_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 AND "noballs" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "legal_deliveries_faced"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "batting_team" = 'Rajasthan Royals'
), FirstToHundred AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowling_team",
    MIN("legal_deliveries_faced") AS "balls_to_100"
  FROM MatchProgress
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 100
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "bowling_team"
)
SELECT
  T2."bowling_team" AS "opposition",
  T3."season" AS "year",
  (T2."balls_to_100" / 6) || '.' || (T2."balls_to_100" % 6) AS "overs_taken"
FROM FirstToHundred AS T2
JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T2."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T2."balls_to_100" = (
    SELECT
      MIN("balls_to_100")
    FROM FirstToHundred
  );

question: which 5 bowler had the worst economy in powerplay in ipl 2025.out of those who bowled atleast 10 overs.give name and economy.
gold_sql: SELECT T3."player_name", CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."wides" + T1."noballs") AS REAL) * 6.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 AND T1."noballs" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "economy" FROM Deliveries AS T1 INNER JOIN Matches AS T2 ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" INNER JOIN Players AS T3 ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id" WHERE T2."season" = '2025' AND T1."over_number" <= 5 GROUP BY T3."player_name" HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 AND T1."noballs" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 60 ORDER BY "economy" DESC LIMIT 5

       ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END), 2) AS "Economy"
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season = 'IPL 2025'
  AND d.over_number <= 6

GROUP BY d.bowler_id, p.player_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) >= 60
ORDER BY "Economy" DESC

question: IPL లో ఒక టీం కి వ్యతిరేకంగా ఏ 4 క్రీడాకార్ల బ్యాటింగ్ అన్నిటికన్నా మంచిది (కనీసం 500 పరుగులు)? క్రీడాకారి పేరు, ఆవెరేజ్, పరుగులు మరియు వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం రాయండి.
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerAverages AS (
  SELECT
    T2."player_name",
    T1."bowling_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS total_runs,
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS batting_average
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  JOIN "Players" AS T2
    ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."bowling_team"
  HAVING
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 500
    AND COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) > 0
)
SELECT
  "player_name",
  "bowling_team" AS "opponent",
  total_runs,
  batting_average
FROM PlayerAverages
WHERE batting_average >= (
  SELECT batting_average
  FROM PlayerAverages
  ORDER BY batting_average DESC
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 3
)
ORDER BY batting_average DESC;

question: 4 Fastest IPL 100s (by balls).give the player runs self and opposition team city and year
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS total_runs
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "match_id"
  HAVING
    SUM("runs_scored") >= 100
), CumulativeInnings AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."bowling_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS cumulative_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS balls_faced
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN PlayerInnings AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
), BallsTo100 AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "bowling_team",
    balls_faced,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "striker_id" ORDER BY balls_faced) AS rn
  FROM CumulativeInnings
  WHERE
    cumulative_runs >= 100
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T2.total_runs,
  T1.balls_faced,
  T1."bowling_team",
  T3."city",
  T3."season"
FROM BallsTo100 AS T1
JOIN PlayerInnings AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."striker_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.rn = 1
ORDER BY
  T1.balls_faced ASC
LIMIT 4;

question: *IPL के 4 सबसे तेज़ शतक (गेंदों के हिसाब से)। खिलाड़ी का नाम, बनाए गए रन, विपक्षी टीम, शहर और साल बताएं।**
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS total_runs
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "match_id"
  HAVING
    SUM("runs_scored") >= 100
), CumulativeInnings AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."bowling_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS cumulative_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS balls_faced
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN PlayerInnings AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
), BallsTo100 AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "bowling_team",
    balls_faced,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "striker_id" ORDER BY balls_faced) AS rn
  FROM CumulativeInnings
  WHERE
    cumulative_runs >= 100
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T2.total_runs,
  T1.balls_faced,
  T1."bowling_team",
  T3."city",
  T3."season"
FROM BallsTo100 AS T1
JOIN PlayerInnings AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."striker_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.rn = 1
ORDER BY
  T1.balls_faced ASC
LIMIT 4;

question: IPL ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸੇ ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਔਸਤ ਰੱਖਣ ਵਾਲੇ 4 ਖਿਡਾਰੀ (ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 500 ਰਨ)। ਔਸਤ, ਰਨ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਅਤੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦਿਓ ।
gold_sql:
WITH PlayerAverages AS (
  SELECT
    T2."player_name",
    T1."bowling_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS total_runs,
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS batting_average
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  JOIN "Players" AS T2
    ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."bowling_team"
  HAVING
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 500
    AND COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) > 0
)
SELECT
  "player_name",
  "bowling_team" AS "opponent",
  total_runs,
  batting_average
FROM PlayerAverages
WHERE batting_average >= (
  SELECT batting_average
  FROM PlayerAverages
  ORDER BY batting_average DESC
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 3
)
ORDER BY batting_average DESC;

question: पारी की पहली गेंद पर सबसे ज़्यादा विकेट किस गेंदबाज़ ने लिए हैं? उस गेंदबाज़ का नाम और उन बल्लेबाज़ों के नाम भी बताएं जिन्हें उसने आउट किया है।
gold_sql:
WITH WicketCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "bowler_id",
    COUNT(*) AS WicketCount
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
    AND "ball_number" = 1
    AND "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
    AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
  GROUP BY
    "bowler_id"
), TopBowlers AS (
  SELECT
    "bowler_id"
  FROM WicketCounts
  WHERE
    WicketCount = (
      SELECT
        MAX(WicketCount)
      FROM WicketCounts
    )
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."player_name"
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN TopBowlers AS T2
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."bowler_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_out_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T1."over_number" = 0
  AND T1."ball_number" = 1
  AND T1."wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
  AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out');
gold_answer: ["('Mohammed Shami', 'JH Kallis')", "('Mohammed Shami', 'KL Rahul')", "('Mohammed Shami', 'PD Salt')", "('Mohammed Shami', 'SK Rasheed')"]
generated_sql:
WITH FirstBallWickets AS (
    SELECT
        d.bowler_id,
        d.player_out_id
    FROM
        Deliveries d
    WHERE
        d.over_number = 1 AND
        d.ball_number = 1 AND
        d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND
        d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
)
SELECT
    p1.player_name AS 'Bowler Name',
    p2.player_name AS 'Player Dismissed'
FROM
    FirstBallWickets fbw
JOIN
    Players p1 ON fbw.bowler_id = p1.player_id
JOIN
    Players p2 ON fbw.player_out_id = p2.player_id
GROUP BY
    fbw.bowler_id,
    fbw.player_out_id
ORDER BY
    COUNT(*) DESC

        CASE WHEN m.toss_winner = d.batting_team AND m.toss_decision = 'bat' THEN 'First'

             ELSE 'Second' END AS BattingOrder,
        d.match_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS RunsScored,

WITH InningProgress AS (

question: 5 lowest Lowest PP scores for SRH that were played for complete 20 overs. give score wickets city and year
gold_sql:
WITH FullInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    (
      CASE
        WHEN "batting_team" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
        THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
        ELSE "batting_team"
      END
    ) = 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  HAVING
    MAX("over_number") >= 19
), PowerplayStats AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS score,
    COUNT("player_out_id") AS wickets
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" <= 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
)
SELECT
  T2.score,
  T2.wickets,
  T1.city,
  T1.season AS year
FROM "Matches" AS T1
INNER JOIN PowerplayStats AS T2
  ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
INNER JOIN FullInnings AS T3
  ON T2.match_id = T3.match_id
  AND T2.inning = T3.inning
ORDER BY
  T2.score ASC
LIMIT 5;

    m.city AS "City",

question: SRH के 5 सबसे कम पावरप्ले स्कोर (पूरे 20 ओवर के मैच में) बताएं। स्कोर, विकेट, शहर और साल भी दें।
gold_sql:
WITH FullInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    (
      CASE
        WHEN "batting_team" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
        THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
        ELSE "batting_team"
      END
    ) = 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  HAVING
    MAX("over_number") >= 19
), PowerplayStats AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS score,
    COUNT("player_out_id") AS wickets
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" <= 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
)
SELECT
  T2.score,
  T2.wickets,
  T1.city,
  T1.season AS year
FROM "Matches" AS T1
INNER JOIN PowerplayStats AS T2
  ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
INNER JOIN FullInnings AS T3
  ON T2.match_id = T3.match_id
  AND T2.inning = T3.inning
ORDER BY
  T2.score ASC
LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT

    m.city AS "City",

FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE d.batting_team = 'SRH'
AND d.over_number BETWEEN 1 AND 6
AND d.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE result_type IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY d.match_id
ORDER BY "Powerplay Score" ASC
LIMIT 5;

question: IPL లో ఏ మ్యాచులలో ఒక టీం 15 పరుగుల కన్నా తక్కువలో 4 వికెట్లు పోగొట్టుకున్న తరువాత 140 కన్నా ఎక్కువ స్కోర్ చేశారు? 4 వికెట్లు పడిన సమయం అప్పుడు స్కోర్, చివరి స్కోర్ మరియు టీం యొక్క పేరు రాయండి.
gold_sql:
WITH InningProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_wickets
  FROM "Deliveries"
), FourthWicketFall AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "cumulative_runs" AS score_at_4_wickets
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS rn
    FROM InningProgress
    WHERE
      "cumulative_wickets" = 4
  )
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), FinalScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS final_score
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
)
SELECT
  T1."batting_team",
  T1."score_at_4_wickets",
  T2."final_score"
FROM FourthWicketFall AS T1
JOIN FinalScores AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
WHERE
  T1."score_at_4_wickets" < 15 AND T2."final_score" >= 140;
gold_answer: ["('Delhi Daredevils', 7, 146)", "('Mumbai Indians', 7, 145)", "('Chennai Super Kings', 7, 156)", "('Punjab Kings', 14, 183)", "('Sunrisers Hyderabad', 13, 143)"]
generated_sql:
WITH WicketCounts AS (
    SELECT
        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team,
        d.inning,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.batting_team ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS wicket_count,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.batting_team ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_score
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
),
FinalScores AS (
    SELECT
        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS final_score
    FROM Deliveries d
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.inning
),
MatchFilter AS (
    SELECT
        wc.match_id,
        wc.batting_team,
        wc.cumulative_score AS score_at_4_wickets,
        fs.final_score
    FROM WicketCounts wc
    JOIN FinalScores fs ON wc.match_id = fs.match_id AND wc.batting_team = fs.batting_team
    WHERE wc.wicket_count = 4 AND fs.final_score > 140 AND fs.final_score - wc.cumulative_score < 15
)
SELECT
    mf.batting_team AS "Batting Team",
    mf.score_at_4_wickets AS "Score at 4 Wickets",
    mf.final_score AS "Final Score"
FROM MatchFilter mf
JOIN Matches m ON mf.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season LIKE '%IPL%';

question: MI बनाम CSK मैचों में हुई 100+ रनों की सभी साझेदारियों की सूची दें।
gold_sql:
WITH PartnershipDetails AS (
  SELECT
    T1.match_id,
    T1.inning,
    T1.over_number,
    T1.ball_number,
    MIN(T1.striker_id, T1.non_striker_id) AS p1_id,
    MAX(T1.striker_id, T1.non_striker_id) AS p2_id,
    T1.runs_scored + T1.extra_runs AS total_runs
  FROM Deliveries AS T1
  INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
  WHERE
    (
      T2.team1 = 'Mumbai Indians' AND T2.team2 = 'Chennai Super Kings'
    ) OR (
      T2.team1 = 'Chennai Super Kings' AND T2.team2 = 'Mumbai Indians'
    )
), PartnershipChange AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN p1_id != LAG(p1_id, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY over_number, ball_number) OR p2_id != LAG(p2_id, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY over_number, ball_number)
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_new_partnership
  FROM PartnershipDetails
), PartnershipGroup AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_partnership) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY over_number, ball_number) AS partnership_id
  FROM PartnershipChange
)
SELECT
  T4.player_name,
  T5.player_name,
  SUM(T3.total_runs) AS partnership_runs
FROM PartnershipGroup AS T3
INNER JOIN Players AS T4
  ON T3.p1_id = T4.player_id
INNER JOIN Players AS T5
  ON T3.p2_id = T5.player_id
GROUP BY
  T3.match_id,
  T3.inning,
  T3.partnership_id,
  T4.player_name,
  T5.player_name

  partnership_runs >= 100
ORDER BY

question: ఇన్నింగ్స్ యొక్క మొదటి బంతప్పుడు అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ వికెట్లు ఏ బౌలర్ తీసుకున్నాడు? బౌలర్ యొక్క పేరు మరియు అతన అవుట్ చేసిన క్రీడాకార్ల పేర్లు రాయండి.
gold_sql:
WITH WicketCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "bowler_id",
    COUNT(*) AS WicketCount
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
    AND "ball_number" = 1
    AND "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
    AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
  GROUP BY
    "bowler_id"
), TopBowlers AS (
  SELECT
    "bowler_id"
  FROM WicketCounts
  WHERE
    WicketCount = (
      SELECT
        MAX(WicketCount)
      FROM WicketCounts
    )
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."player_name"
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN TopBowlers AS T2
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."bowler_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_out_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T1."over_number" = 0
  AND T1."ball_number" = 1
  AND T1."wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
  AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out');
